The armors remained unscratched, despite having taken blows from some of the fiercest dragons to ever roam the land. 11450946--.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Signal Amplifier</font>
When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Lumiknights: Increases health by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>2000</font>
· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>
· Royal Guard: Increases accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font>
· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec
· Maple Alliance: Increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>220</font>

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>
11450946--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis gear is coated in lodestar, a magical alloy developed by Sky Fortress's R&D team. 11450957--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nExclusive combat gear of the Crimson Balrogs, the most elite band of balrog soldiers. 11460074--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>An expertly crafted piece of armor that once belonged to Athanasia, the legendary Dragon Hunter. Athanasia is said to have specially crafted a suit of armor for each dragon she would face, and their craftsmanship was without peer. The armors remained unscratched, despite having taken blows from some of the fiercest dragons to ever roam the land. Athanasia guaranteed her armor for the lifespan of its wearer, though this claim was never put to the test, as the whole lot of them vanished mysteriously long ago.</font>

11550850--.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Signal Amplifier</font>
When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Lumiknights: Increases health by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>2000</font>
· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>
· Royal Guard: Increases accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font>
· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec
· Maple Alliance: Increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>220</font>

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>
11550850--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis gear is coated in lodestar, a magical alloy developed by Sky Fortress's R&D team. When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Lumiknights: Increases health by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>2000</font>
· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>
· Royal Guard: Increases accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font>
· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec
· Maple Alliance: Increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>220</font>

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>
11550857--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis gear is coated in lodestar, a magical alloy developed by Sky Fortress's R&D team. It protects the wearer from environments with unusual magical hazards without the need for a bulky HAZMAG suit. Specially requisitioned for the mission to defeat Infernog.</font>

11560075--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>An expertly crafted piece of armor that once belonged to Athanasia, the legendary Dragon Hunter. Athanasia is said to have specially crafted a suit of armor for each dragon she would face, and their craftsmanship was without peer. The armors remained unscratched, despite having taken blows from some of the fiercest dragons to ever roam the land. Athanasia guaranteed her armor for the lifespan of its wearer, though this claim was never put to the test, as the whole lot of them vanished mysteriously long ago.</font>

"Perhaps my greatest shame can be put to good use in your hands." - Ishura

11651019--.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Signal Amplifier</font>
When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Lumiknights: Increases health by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>2000</font>
· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>
· Royal Guard: Increases accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font>
· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec
· Maple Alliance: Increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>220</font>

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>

When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Lumiknights: Increases health by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>2000</font>
· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>
· Royal Guard: Increases accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font>
· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec
· Maple Alliance: Increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>220</font>

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>

11651030--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nExclusive combat gear of the Crimson Balrogs, the most elite band of balrog soldiers. Although it was created using forgotten techniques and thus can't be repaired with modern techniques, this gear will never break until all wars end in this world.</font>

11651041--.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Malevolent Energies</font>
Chance to consume health instead of spirit for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>7</font> sec on hit when using skills. The amount of health consumed is proportional to the amount of spirit the skill costs.

Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.</font>
11651041--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThe material used to craft this gear was forged in Infernog's hellfire. Despite the fact that it's stronger than normal gear, the Lumiknights were hesitant to issue it, due to its ties to the ancient demon. "Our way of life may be hanging by a thread, but there are certain lines we do not cross. Let this be the one exception." - Templar Mason</font>

11660084--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An expertly crafted piece of armor that once belonged to Athanasia, the legendary Dragon Hunter. Athanasia is said to have specially crafted a suit of armor for each dragon she would face, and their craftsmanship was without peer. The armors remained unscratched, despite having taken blows from some of the fiercest dragons to ever roam the land. Athanasia guaranteed her armor for the lifespan of its wearer, though this claim was never put to the test, as the whole lot of them vanished mysteriously long ago.</font>

When a faction's flare is used while on an Orbis-class aircraft carrier, obtain that faction's aid for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>15</font> min.

· Dark Wind: Increases evasion by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>50</font>

· Green Hoods: Restores <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>150</font> health every sec

Effect ends upon leaving the area the flare was used.</font>

11751116--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThe material used to craft this gear was forged in Infernog's hellfire. 11760105--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An expertly crafted piece of armor that once belonged to Athanasia, the legendary Dragon Hunter. 12100077--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nKandura was an apostate member of the Guidance and the leader of BeyondLink. Known as the Tris Project A series, they tested their creation in the form of a belt which inadvertently transformed the test subject into a mass of shadows. The researchers have attempted to cover up the results of their experiment, but the A series remains hidden somewhere, creating ever more ravenous shadows.</font>

Active while $item:14160263$ is equipped.
13160306-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment crafted for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders. Durable materials supplemented with protective dark magics make its bearer a true menace on the battlefield.</font>

13160307-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: Chaotic Energies\nChance to trigger either Life, Space, or Time buff on hit. Empowers up to 10 allies (including yourself) within 6 m. [Life] Restores 5,000 health. [Space] Increases accuracy by 3 and piercing by 3% for 15 sec. [Time] Increases attack speed and movement speed by 3% for 15 sec. Must have $item:13160299$ equipped in both hands. Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.
13160307-Level60Item-.guideDescription: This gear was created using shards of armor worn by the Terrun Calibre commanders when they were under the influence of dark lapenta. Though it's been purified, it still pulses with great power. If its wearer acts with discretion and skill, then that power can be theirs. "Perhaps my greatest shame can be put to good use in your hands." - Ishura

13160308-PvPRankingDuelMode-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Gladiator</font>\nIncreases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>21300</font> in battlegrounds and arenas. Must have an Enhanced Refinement Dagger equipped in both hands.

13160309-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear made from lumarigon scales. It's unclear how such an item came to Kritias, where there's no record of lumarigon activity, but its offensive and defensive capabilities are without question.</font>

13160310-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

13160311-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Aetherine Trigger</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>12</font> sec on hit if you learned Poison Plan. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. Active while the same gear is equipped in both hands. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
13160311-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the officers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. With boosted aetherine efficiency, this item has formidable offense and defense.</font>

13160312-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Ancient Power</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>36</font> sec on hit during Extemporaneous. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. Active while the same gear is equipped in both hands. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
13160312-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

13160313-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Bombardment Support</font>\nHumanitas forces bombards nearby enemies on hit, dealing <font color='#ff8ae5'>685%</font> damage every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> sec. Must have Tairen Royal Knife equipped in both hands. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.
13160313-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. It's mostly used for ceremonial purposes, but the technology integrated within is cutting edge—perhaps a direct gift from its designer, the AI Jessica, to the royals. It is as majestic as is fitting for its intended wearer.</font>

13250147--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This item once belonged to an ancient warrior tribe that entered the Land of Darkness in search of conquest and glory during the War of Light and Darkness. 13250281-Season3-NA.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Extremity</font>\nChance to increase attack speed by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>6%</font> and movement speed by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12%</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>10</font> sec on hit. 13250283-Season3-NA.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Shadow Hunter</font>\nChance to increase physical attack and magic attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>9%</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>11</font> sec on hit. 13260149--.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5'>Flame Orb</font>
Chance to accumulate a flame orb on hit. Each orb increases physical attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>3</font>.

<font color='#ff8ae5'>Meteor</font>
At <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> flame orbs, a blazing meteor crashes down, dealing <font color='#ff8ae5'>210%</font> damage <font color='#ff8ae5'>3</font> times to <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> enemies. All orbs are consumed when Meteor triggers.

Item abilities inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.</font>
13260149--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>A weapon of unparalleled craftsmanship designed for a singular purpose: the slaying of dragons. It was forged for personal use by Athanasia, a legendary dragon hunter famous for mastering over 13 types of weapons. Nearly all the weapons she had crafted mysteriously vanished long ago.</font>

13260190--.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5'>Narubashan's Fury</font>\nUse Tornado Slash after <font color='#ff8ae5'>6</font> basic attacks to increase the attack speed of <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> allies within <font color='#ff8ae5'>6</font> m by <font color='#ff8ae5'>35%</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>25</font> sec. This effect can only happen once every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> minutes. In battlegrounds and arenas, weapon attack is reduced by half, and Narubashan's Fury will not trigger.
13260190--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>The unfettered power of Narubashan emanates from this item.</font>

13360304-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

13360305-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Aetherine Trigger</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec on hit if you learned Wrath Eternal. 13360306-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

13360307-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. 15060305-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment crafted for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders. Durable materials supplemented with protective dark magics make its bearer a true menace on the battlefield.</font>

15060306-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: Chaotic Energies Chance to trigger either Life, Space, or Time buff on hit. Empowers up to 10 allies (including yourself) within 6 m. [Life] Restores 5,000 health. [Space] Increases accuracy by 3 and piercing by 3% for 15 sec. [Time] Increases attack speed and movement speed by 3% for 15 sec. Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.
15060306-Level60Item-.guideDescription: This gear was created using shards of armor worn by the Terrun Calibre commanders when they were under the influence of dark lapenta. Though it's been purified, it still pulses with great power. If its wearer acts with discretion and skill, then that power can be theirs. "Perhaps my greatest shame can be put to good use in your hands." - Ishura

15060307-PvPRankingDuelMode-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Gladiator</font>\nIncreases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>21300</font> in battlegrounds and arenas.

15060308-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear made from lumarigon scales. It's unclear how such an item came to Kritias, where there's no record of lumarigon activity, but its offensive and defensive capabilities are without question.</font>

15060309-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

15060310-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Aetherine Trigger</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>36</font> sec upon hitting with Sever. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15060310-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the officers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. With boosted aetherine efficiency, this item has formidable offense and defense.</font>

15060311-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Ancient Power</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>48</font> sec upon hitting with Dusk Fall. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15060311-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

15060312-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Bombardment Support</font>\nHumanitas forces bombards nearby enemies on hit, dealing <font color='#ff8ae5'>685%</font> damage every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> sec. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.
15060312-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. It's mostly used for ceremonial purposes, but the technology integrated within is cutting edge—perhaps a direct gift from its designer, the AI Jessica, to the royals. It is as majestic as is fitting for its intended wearer.</font>

According to Time Traveler Andy's analysis, it is capable of protecting its bearer from temporal anomalies.</font>

15260296-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Power Surge</font>\n<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>10%</font> chance to increase bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>400</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font> sec on hit.
15260296-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment crafted for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders. Durable materials supplemented with protective dark magics make its bearer a true menace on the battlefield.</font>

15260297-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: Chaotic Energies Chance to trigger either Life, Space, or Time buff on hit. Empowers up to 10 allies (including yourself) within 6 m. [Life] Restores 5,000 health. [Space] Increases accuracy by 3 and piercing by 3% for 15 sec. [Time] Increases attack speed and movement speed by 3% for 15 sec. Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.
15260297-Level60Item-.guideDescription: This gear was created using shards of armor worn by the Terrun Callibre commanders when they were under the influence of dark lapenta. Though it's been purified, it still pulses with great power. If its wearer acts with discretion and skill, then that power can be theirs. "Perhaps my greatest shame can be put to good use in your hands." - Ishura

15260299-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment once worn by crew serving under Captain Moc, fearsome pirate and scourge of the seas. It's been enchanted to provide warmth even in the most violent of storms.</font>

15260300-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>A special armor set designed for the Frontier Foundation. Originally intended for widespread use, it turned out to be too expensive to mass produce and never saw large-scale distribution.</font>

15260301-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment bestowed upon the few loyal fanatics who earned Madria's favor. In spite of its wicked design, it affords protection without sacrificing mobility, and is imbued with protective magics.</font>

15260302-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Beastly Rage</font>\n<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>10%</font> chance to increase physical and magic attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>48</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font> sec on hit.
15260302-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment crafted from the remains of a gigantic beast that once terrorized the tundras of Victoria Island. It is nearly indestructible, and is said to be possessed by the bloodthirsty behemoth whose bones and sinew it is hewn from.</font>

15260303-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Ravaging Strikes</font>\n<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>10%</font> chance to increase accuracy by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>9</font> and attack speed by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>9%</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>12</font> sec on hit.
15260303-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This mysterious item was said to have arrived in Maple World through a rift in space-time. It is made of an unknown material that is incredibly strong and exceptionally lightweight. According to Andy the Time Traveler's analysis, it is capable of protecting its bearer from temporal anomalies.</font>

15260304-Level60Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment crafted for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders. Durable materials supplemented with protective dark magics make its bearer a true menace on the battlefield.</font>

Though it's been purified, it still pulses with great power. If its wearer acts with discretion and skill, then that power can be theirs. "Perhaps my greatest shame can be put to good use in your hands." - Ishura

15260306-PvPRankingDuelMode-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Gladiator</font>\nIncreases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>21300</font> in battlegrounds and arenas.

15260307-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear made from lumarigon scales. It's unclear how such an item came to Kritias, where there's no record of lumarigon activity, but its offensive and defensive capabilities are without question.</font>

15260308-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

15260309-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Aetherine Trigger</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>48</font> sec upon hitting with Hurricane Warning. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15260309-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the officers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. With boosted aetherine efficiency, this item has formidable offense and defense.</font>

15260310-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Ancient Power</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>36</font> sec upon hitting enemy inflicted by Raging Flame. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15260310-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

15260311-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Bombardment Support</font>\nHumanitas forces bombards nearby enemies on hit, dealing <font color='#ff8ae5'>685%</font> damage every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> sec. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.
15260311-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. It's mostly used for ceremonial purposes, but the technology integrated within is cutting edge—perhaps a direct gift from its designer, the AI Jessica, to the royals. It is as majestic as is fitting for its intended wearer.</font>

15460189-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

15460191-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

15460192-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. It is as majestic as is fitting for its intended wearer.</font>

It's probably best to undo $npcName:23090005$'s curse before you use them.

15500065-Striker-.tooltipDescription: When $item:15500064$ were thrown on the undying flame, $npc:23090005$'s curse was undone and his power was bestowed upon these knuckles. The flames have only made them more potent.

15500080-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Knuckles imbued with the power of Pyrros Fard. They grant their wearer a portion of Pyrros Fard's strength.
15500080-Striker-.guideDescription: Triggered effects inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.

15500081-Striker-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5'>Raging Extinction</font>\nHas an <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font> chance to deal <font color='#ff8ae5'>270%</font> electric damage on hit. Can only trigger once every <font color='#ff8ae5'>8</font> sec. Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.
15500081-Striker-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>A weapon infused with the fury of the Land of Darkness, where battle never ceases. Detonates the power of lightning to instantly lead enemies to their graves.</font>

15500091-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Knuckles for combatants willing to test their limits in the scorching desert.
15500091-Striker-.guideDescription: Item abilities inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.

15500095-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Popular amongst folks who eke out a life on the streets.

15500096-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Popular amongst folks who eke out a life on the streets.

15500097-Striker-.tooltipDescription: A weapon favored by crooks who travel in and out of the Land of Darkness for their shady dealings.

15500098-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Members of Dark Wind use weapons like this when it's time to defend the city.

15500100-Striker-.tooltipDescription: The guardians of Maple World use weapons like this to fight demon lords.

15500101-Striker-.tooltipDescription: The secret agents of the Maple Guardians are outfitted with these. They're made from materials only found in Taliskar.

15500102-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Anyone below the rank of commander in the Royal Guard is forbidden from wielding a weapon such as this.

15500103-Striker-.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000604$ discovered this beneath the burning tree in Peronia Woods. It may be scorched, but it's still useful.

15500104-Striker-.tooltipDescription: A potent life force flows from the green lapenta.

15500105-Striker-.tooltipDescription: An absentminded warrior left this behind after taking a quick nap.

15500106-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Highly valued by members of Blackstar. There's a hidden black star engraved on this.

15500107-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Traded secretly in the back alleys, amongst those loyal and true to one another.

15500108-Striker-.tooltipDescription: It's studded with a type of black stone that members of Blackstar trade.

15500109-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Represents the pride of the Gray Wolf.

15500110-Striker-.tooltipDescription: Outfitted with a device that senses and absorbs nearby latent energy. Optimizing its application of force makes this tremendously effective and frighteningly destructive.

15500123--.tooltipDescription: The spirit of Narubashan flows through this ancient gear.
15500123--.guideDescription: Weapon attack is reduced by half in battlefields and arenas.

15500124--.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5'>Narubashan's Fury</font>\nUse Fists of Fury after <font color='#ff8ae5'>6</font> basic attacks to increase the attack speed of <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> allies within <font color='#ff8ae5'>6</font> m by <font color='#ff8ae5'>35%</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>25</font> sec. This ability can only trigger once every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> minutes. In battlegrounds and arenas, weapon attack is reduced by half, and Narubashan's Fury will not trigger.
15500124--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>The unfettered power of Narubashan emanates from this item.</font>

15500125--.tooltipDescription: Knuckles made for heroes who fight without fear or hesitation.
15500125--.guideDescription: Triggered effects inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.

15500126--.tooltipDescription: This gear was forged for heroes who put their honor on the line and competed with their all!

15500128--.tooltipDescription: Knuckles generously provided to friends of the gray wolf. They are intended to be used for justice.

15500135-Mastery-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5'>Raging Extinction</font>\nHas an <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font> chance to deal <font color='#ff8ae5'>270%</font> electric damage on hit. Can only trigger once every <font color='#ff8ae5'>8</font> sec. Inactive in battlegrounds and arenas.
15500135-Mastery-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>A weapon infused with the fury of the Land of Darkness, where battle never ceases. Detonates the power of lightning to instantly lead enemies to their graves.</font>

15500141--.tooltipDescription: This weapon bears the power of Alvanos, who has dominion over the sea. It may be able to awaken your latent potential.

15500142--.tooltipDescription: This weapon carries the sorrow of Erda, who lost both her kingdom and Bjorn. The might of the blizzard of tears strengthens any who would use this.

15500143--.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>In battlegrounds and arenas, bonus damage reduced by half, and triggered effects are inactive.</font>
15500143--.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\n"The modern soldier takes up the gun and the cannon, while the romantic warrior clings foolishly to the sword. But the fallen dragons knew a secret. The true champion... fights with her fists." - Excerpt from the Records of a Corrupted King</font>

15600063-SoulBinder-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>A weapon created by processing the fragment of Nutaman the Rune Titan.\nIt is recorded that a spell was placed on Nutaman to detect the challenger's power and will in order to discern the one worthy to inherit the power of the rune. That is why the possessor of this majestic weapon is tested continually, and it is said that it overcomes the owner and runs wild in situations where one's limits are being challenged.</font>

15660065-SoulBinder-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>The legendary Dragon Hunter. A first class weapon of Athanasia's anti-dragon equipment. Among those many types, the ones called the 'Undying' were the best among the 20 tiers and were created with the best material and technique, making them masterpieces worthy of being called Dragon Hunters. Although Athanasia and their weapons disappeared without a trace one day, based on the legends, the 'Undying' weapons lay dormant as eternal mementos in the hands of a great evil.</font>

15660229-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear made from lumarigon scales. It's unclear how such an item came to Kritias, where there's no record of lumarigon activity, but its offensive and defensive capabilities are without question.</font>

15660230-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the soldiers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. Stolen during the prototyping phase, this item has a balance of offense and defense.</font>

15660231-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Aetherine Trigger</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>72</font> sec upon hitting with Power Liberation. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15660231-Level70Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat gear for the officers of Tairen. Jessica designed it specifically to defeat Humanitas. With boosted aetherine efficiency, this item has formidable offense and defense.</font>

15660232-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Ancient Power</font>\nIncreases physical and magic damage by <font color='#ff8ae5'>8%</font>, and increases bonus attack by <font color='#ff8ae5'>1,000</font> for <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec on hit if you learned Perfect Melody. Bonus attack increase has a <font color='#ff8ae5'>10</font> sec cooldown. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.</font>
15660232-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Gear from ancient Kritias. The design seems to imply that the ancients either revered Infernog... or were trying to warn future generations of the danger he represents. In either case, the power imbued within is formidable.</font>

15660233-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>Bombardment Support</font>\nHumanitas forces bombards nearby enemies on hit, dealing <font color='#ff8ae5'>685%</font> damage every <font color='#ff8ae5'>5</font> sec. The effect can't be triggered in battlegrounds or arenas.
15660233-Level70Item-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>This accessory is granted only to the direct royal line of Tairen. It's mostly used for ceremonial purposes, but the technology integrated within is cutting edge—perhaps a direct gift from its designer, the AI Jessica, to the royals. It is as majestic as is fitting for its intended wearer.</font>

20001698-Wedding-.mainDescription: Create a portal to the commemorative photo map.
20001698-Wedding-.tooltipDescription: This is a commemorative photo ticket that can be used by the newly wed couple at the wedding hall from the time the officiant declares marriage until the closing of the wedding hall. At the bottom of the item, small letters read, 'Congratulations on your wedding! Capture this happy moment!' After taking commemorative photos, you can return to the wedding hall through the portal.
20001698-Wedding-.guideDescription: Double-clicking the item in your inventory will open a portal that will take you to the commemorative photo map.

20001701-Wedding-.tooltipDescription: 결혼식장에서 신랑 또는 신부가 주례의 성혼 선언 이후부터 결혼식장 폐쇄 전까지 사용할 수 있는 애프터 파티 티켓이다. 사용 시 현재 채널의 현재 위치에 입장 포털이 생기고 포털을 통해 자유롭게 애프터 파티 맵에 입장할 수 있다. 아이템 하단에 작은 글씨로 `결혼 축하해요! 손님들과 함께 즐거운 파티를 즐겨보세요!'이라고 적혀있다. 애프터 파티를 진행한 후, 포털을 통해 결혼식장으로 돌아올 수 있다.

20300001--.tooltipDescription: A voucher that grants access to Maple World's special shop.
20300001--.guideDescription: This voucher can be used to hire an assistant, or to customize your character at $npcName:11000255$'s Beauty Shop, Marcus's Dye Workshop, or a plastic surgeon.

20300002--.tooltipDescription: A welcome pack full of goodies to help you on  your adventures.
20300002--.guideDescription: Double-click this item in your inventory to get what's inside.

20300003--.tooltipDescription: A single-use walkie-talkie that will summon a Rotors Air helicopter taxi.
20300003--.guideDescription: Select a location on your map and click the helicopter icon to travel there. It costs <font color='#00aaef'>1</font> walkie-talkie to go somewhere you've been before, and <font color='#00aaef'>3</font> walkie-talkies to travel to a new location.

20300004--.tooltipDescription: A magic key that creates more keys. Magic this powerful takes time to recharge. Has a cooldown of <font color='#00aaef'>24</font> hours.
20300004--.guideDescription: Double-click the item in your inventory window to use it.

20300005--.tooltipDescription: Adds <font color='#00aaef'>6</font> slots to the gear, furnishing, mount, and misc tabs of your inventory. Each tab can have up to <font color='#00aaef'>48</font> slots. Cannot be used if you've already reached maximum capacity.
20300005--.guideDescription: Double-click the item in your inventory window to use it.

20300006--.tooltipDescription: This voucher allows you to change your name. You will be logged out after changing your name. The new name will appear when you log back in.
20300006--.guideDescription: Double-click the item in your inventory window to use it.

20300007--.tooltipDescription:
This voucher will change your character's gender. You will be logged out after changing your gender. When you log back in, your gender will be changed, and your hair and face will be updated to match the corresponding gender in the image below.
<font color='#ff5f5f'>Note that any gender-specific outfit items in your inventory will NOT be updated.</font>
20300007--.guideDescription: Double-click the item in your inventory window to use it. Note that the gender of any outfits and weapon skins you own will not be changed.
