30000001--.tooltipDescription: Latent flame absorbed by $npcName:21000087$. Collect 50, gather them in a reliquary at $map:02000049$, then say the magic words to make $item:30000201$.

30000002--.tooltipDescription: Fishing tackle you can sell to a merchant.

30000003--.tooltipDescription: A net you can sell to a merchant.

30000004--.tooltipDescription: An antique vase of unknown origin.

30000005--.tooltipDescription: An antique shard of unknown origin.

30000006--.tooltipDescription: An old book written in an ancient language. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000007--.tooltipDescription: The fossil of an ancient aquatic creature. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000008--.tooltipDescription: A pearl with a beautiful shine. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000009--.tooltipDescription: A squishy red starfish. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000010--.tooltipDescription: A hard pebble. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000011--.tooltipDescription: A sharp $npcName:21000059$ claw. Can be sold to a merchant.

30000015--.tooltipDescription: Mud commonly found under the rocks in $map:02000051$. Mixed with a lot of moss.

30000016--.tooltipDescription: A precious ore only found in the Land of Darkness. It takes the highest skill to polish this black stone.

30000017--.tooltipDescription: This key opens the barbed wire fence that blocks the 8th floor of the Golden Tower.

30000018--.tooltipDescription: A record of $npcName:11000173$'s transactions. Mentions an iron deal with $npcName:11000171$ of $map:02000100$.

30000019--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000172$'s master key. Opens the rental storage building in $map:02000064$.

30000020--.tooltipDescription: A suspicious ledger listing transactions by date.

30000022--.tooltipDescription: A message for $npcName:11000492$. "We've been found out! I'm going to $map:52000037$ in $map:02000043$. Come find me!"

30000023--.tooltipDescription: This old notebook lists various transactions. It was dropped by the $npcName:11003167$ in $map:52000037$.

30000024--.tooltipDescription: A photo of $npcName:11000012$ and an old lady smiling together. Found in a cargo box that belongs to $npcName:11000492$.

30000025--.tooltipDescription: The last letter $npcName:11000492$ sent to his mother before disappearing.

30000026--.tooltipDescription: A mesh bag $npcName:11000190$ uses to store herbs.

30000028--.tooltipDescription: A maple branch infused with the power to disrupt ice magic.

30000029--.tooltipDescription: A ball of light carried by $npcName:21000069$. Put your ears against it to hear music that fills you with the desire of dance.

30000031--.tooltipDescription: A bag full of black mushrooms collected by $npcName:11000190$. Give it to Hofmann's wife.

30000032--.tooltipDescription: A tool used to dig out clams along the beach.

30000033--.tooltipDescription: A message from $npcName:11000074$ to $npcName:11000075$ in a sealed envelope. By the look on $npcName:11000074$'s face, it might be about $npcName:11000057$.

30000034--.tooltipDescription: A list of adventurers you've defeated.

30000035--.tooltipDescription: A circuit board taken from a robot. Used to hack communication devices.

30000036--.tooltipDescription: An ID card that belongs to $npcName:11000526$, the leader of the Barrota Trading Company.

30000037--.tooltipDescription: A badge belonging to the head of the Barrota Trading Company.

30000038--.tooltipDescription: A wanted poster for $npcName:11000064$, issued for the murder of Winn Stilton.

30000039--.tooltipDescription: This bottle used to contain a sample of an experimental medicine.

30000040--.tooltipDescription: A USB stick containing the hacking files $npcName:11000594$ created using $item:30000035$.

30000041--.tooltipDescription: Bullies took this brand new jacket from $npcName:11000526$.

30000042--.tooltipDescription: Bullies took these brand new sneakers from $npcName:11000526$.

30000043--.tooltipDescription: A blueprint of Fellowstone Tower, a futuristic high-rise tower.

30000044--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000221$ lovingly prepared this lunch for her father, $npcName:11000222$.

30000045--.tooltipDescription: It's unclear who owns this key. It doesn't look all that useful.

30000046--.tooltipDescription: A ring $npcName:11000223$ gave to $npcName:11000224$ as a token of love.

30000047--.tooltipDescription: A mysterious bag that was found behind the altar of $map:02000229$.

30000049--.tooltipDescription: An analysis of the medicine produced by Goldus Pharmaceutical.

30000052--.tooltipDescription: Part of the oil pipeline. It's too corroded to be of any use.

30000053--.tooltipDescription: A cardboard box often used when moving house.

30000054--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000110$ collected this maple seed from the hills of $map:63000001$. Nutritious and delicious, it's used in many dishes.

30000055--.tooltipDescription: This rock used to be common in the Vayar Mountains. Now that the Vayar Mountains have split, it's become very rare.

30000056--.tooltipDescription: This stone is infused with ancient knowledge. The stone giants of ancient Vayar used to carry it with them to gain supernatural insight. They became puppets of evil when their stones were corrupted. You can sense the location of other cachamaxai with this rock.

30000058--.tooltipDescription: A fragmented shard of the Blue Lapenta. Mysterious spies stole it from the Command Center.

30000059--.tooltipDescription: A weekly real estate brochure issued to the brokers of Goldus Real Estate. Filled with information about house rentals.

30000061--.tooltipDescription: An official recommendation from $npcName:11000076$ for you as a defender of Maple World.

30000062--.tooltipDescription: A book written by Moda, a pioneer in the field of geology. It's one of the oldest known works on the subject.

30000063--.tooltipDescription: Research notes prepared by a young geologist. They focus on mysterious and unexplained geological phenomena.

30000064--.tooltipDescription: Tells the story of Dr. Renovo, a man who once dug an underground tunnel to study the principles of geology.

30000065--.tooltipDescription: A "love potion" made from the tears of $npcName:11000285$, a romantic turtle who pines for a lover who passed away. It looks suspiciously like water.

30000066--.tooltipDescription: A bag containing cash and records of illicit dealings. $npcName:11000529$ offered this bag to someone who would reveal the secret of $npcName:11000044$.

30000067--.tooltipDescription: An ancient book containing every bit of $npcName:11000042$'s peerless magic knowledge.

30000068--.tooltipDescription: An ancient tribe gave this lucky charm to $npcName:23000020$ as a token of respect. Place it in your home for pleasant dreams and inspiration.

30000069--.tooltipDescription: Glass slippers belonging to $npcName:11000284$. She's never worn them for fear they might break.

30000070--.tooltipDescription: Ingredients for a banquet in the empress's honor. There's only a little left after the recent earthquake.

30000071--.tooltipDescription: Young frogs from $map:02000022$. They're natural prey to the native lizards. Release them on the lotus leaves in $map:02000022$ to keep them safe.

30000072--.tooltipDescription: A rare fish from the deepest waters of Ellua River. Fishing enthusiasts the world over compete to get their hands on this fish.

30000073--.tooltipDescription: Material taken from $npcName:21090182$. It has a broad grain pattern, making it ideal for building instruments.

30000074--.tooltipDescription: A bucket borrowed from Jake the farmer. It's been filled with water.

30000075--.tooltipDescription: A list of the contracts between $npcName:11000526$ and $npcName:11000044$, as well as other services that have been performed.

30000076--.tooltipDescription: A small flame capable of purifying souls and objects of demonic influence. It was taken from an everlasting flame of purification.

30000078--.tooltipDescription: A blueprint discarded by $npcName:11000353$. Use the blank side to take notes.

30000079--.tooltipDescription: A book of matches. Perfect for starting a fire.

30000080--.tooltipDescription: The evil $npcName:11000303$ dropped this mask upon death.

30000081--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000052$'s claw. Sharp and hard, it is often used to make sewing needles.

30000082--.tooltipDescription: The font in this book is so small that it's hard to read. It looks like someone placed it on the wrong bookshelf because they couldn't read the title.

30000083--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000335$'s master key. It unlocks the robot storage in $map:02000163$.

30000084--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000335$'s latest invention, a robot with full artificial intelligence. Made-to-order for the wealthiest 0.1%.

30000085--.tooltipDescription: The Pigmings use this as an offering in their rituals.

30000086--.tooltipDescription: Shiny, golden sand found in some parts of the Vayar Mountains. Known for its power to purify souls.

30000087--.tooltipDescription: A history book containing records and anecdotes of Maple World.

30000088--.tooltipDescription: A mask taken from a $npcName:21000225$. Legend has it that you can summon $npcName:21000425$ by placing it on the altar at $map:02000047$.

30000090--.tooltipDescription: A feather infused with the holy power of Vayar. Believed to bring good luck.

30000091--.tooltipDescription: Signature bread baked by the Mendel Confectionery. Simple yet addictive.

30000092--.tooltipDescription: An axe made from sturdy bamboo and knife-like blades. $npcName:11000203$'s name is carved on the handle.

30000093--.tooltipDescription: This wooden horn was created with the help of $npcName:11000479$ of $map:02000076$. Because it makes a sound similar to the call of a $npcName:23000019$, $npcName:23000021$ will open the gate if you play this horn in front of his nest in $map:02000046$.

30000095--.tooltipDescription: A time capsule containing the memories of Manu and his wife Madelle.

30000096--.tooltipDescription: A key to one of Kumbawanka's treasures.

30000097--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:29000023$'s cape. Gives off a mysterious light.

30000098--.tooltipDescription: This ice pack will come in handy on hot summer days.

30000099--.tooltipDescription: A red meteorite fragment. Polish it to make a nice conversation starter for your home.

30000100--.tooltipDescription: A blue meteorite fragment. Polish it to make a nice conversation starter for your home.

30000101--.tooltipDescription: A green meteorite fragment. Polish it to make a nice conversation starter for your home.

30000102--.tooltipDescription: A key for a locked bookcase.

30000103--.tooltipDescription: A flier for iron distributed by $npcName:11000173$.

30000104--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000368$'s potion. It speeds up tree growth.

30000105--.tooltipDescription: A record if iron deals between $npcName:11000173$ and $npcName:11000171$. It will come in handy when interrogating $npcName:11000171$.

30000106--.tooltipDescription: Contains an electronic chip that can open $npcName:11000173$'s safe.

30000107--.tooltipDescription: Dark energy removed from $npcName:11000304$'s $item:30000187$ in order to temporarily purify it.

30000108--.tooltipDescription: It's unclear who owns this flask. Doesn't look all that useful.

30000109--.tooltipDescription: A camera with an excellent zoom lens.

30000111--.tooltipDescription: This balloon belongs to $npcName:11000389$, the balloon peddler.

30000114--.tooltipDescription: This style of notebook is often used as a ledger by members of the Barrota Trading Company. Its owner is unknown.

30000115--.tooltipDescription: It's unclear who owns this pendant. Doesn't look all that useful.

30000116--.tooltipDescription: A shiny bolt exclusively used in city water tanks.

30000117--.tooltipDescription: An oxidized and corroded bolt from a city water tank.

30000118--.tooltipDescription: This money was taken from a convenience store cash register.

30000120--.tooltipDescription: A mass of old and rusty scrap iron. It can be melted in a waste-treatment plant furnace.

30000121--.tooltipDescription: Made by melting scrap iron in a furnace. Solidify it to make iron ore.

30000122--.tooltipDescription: Pudding made by $npcName:11000002$. It's sweet, delicious, and dangerously addictive.

30000123--.tooltipDescription: This conical tree was cultivated by $npcName:11000368$.

30000127--.tooltipDescription: It's unclear who owns this ring. Doesn't look all that useful.

30000128--.tooltipDescription: Hard and tasteless. $npcName:21090071$ likes to chuck these apples at enemies.

30000129--.tooltipDescription: A lovingly packed lunch for $npcName:11000111$'s uncle. It shows how much $npcName:11000111$ cares.

30000131--.tooltipDescription: Alberto whittled this jewel box by hand. It's empty and waiting to be filled.

30000132--.tooltipDescription: A ruby necklace Alberto gave to Roanna as a token of everlasting love. Its brilliant shine has stood the test of time.

30000133--.tooltipDescription: Roanna's jewel box. It contains the ruby necklace Alberto gave her as a token of everlasting love.

30000134--.tooltipDescription: A picture of $npcName:11000424$'s granddaughter, Maggie. Old and faded, you can feel how much $npcName:11000424$ misses her.

30000135--.tooltipDescription: Maggie, the granddaughter of $npcName:11000424$, made this headband for her doll. It's adorned with a big purple ribbon.

30000136--.tooltipDescription: A box for storing precious items. It contains the diamond engagement ring $npcName:11000325$ purchased for his girlfriend.

30000137--.tooltipDescription: Toh used to carry this copper key. It might open the lock on the gate to the mine. It's said to be Toh's den.

30000138--.tooltipDescription: Thick, green sap extracted from the stalks and leaves of $npcName:21000038$. It smells terrible, but it's coveted for its magical properties.

30000140--.tooltipDescription: A corn dog made of fresh $npcName:21000059$. Every bite is juicy and delicious.

30000141--.tooltipDescription: An ornithology encyclopedia written by Dr. Elivan. It contains information on every bird living in Maple World.

30000142--.tooltipDescription: This red ore is commonly found in regions with active volcanic activity.

30000144--.tooltipDescription: A topical cream created by $npcName:11000695$ to lift transfiguration curses.

30000145--.tooltipDescription: A residency permit for the apartment buildings built by the Goldus Construction Company.
30000145--.guideDescription: Grants access to Maple Apartments in $map:02000119$ for 30 days.

30000146--.tooltipDescription:
Contains various furnishings for your land. The ideal package for designing a modern house.

<font color='#ff5400'>Double-click the package in your inventory after purchase.
</font>

30000147--.tooltipDescription: A rare opal. You could sell it to a merchant for a good price.

30000148--.tooltipDescription: A rare sapphire. You could sell it to a merchant for a good price.

30000149--.tooltipDescription: A precious diamond. You could sell it to a merchant for a good price.

30000150--.tooltipDescription: A logbook of $npcName:11000444$'s 10-year voyage. It's become hard to read due to water smearing the ink on the pages.

30000151--.tooltipDescription: A navigation permit issued by the Adventurer's Guild. You need this permit to anchor your ship at docks around Maple World.

30000152--.tooltipDescription: This deed certifies that this land belongs to $npcName:11000342$. Does not guarantee home insurance. Call the number on the back for more information.

30000153--.tooltipDescription: Imbued with the souls of the heroes who defeated $npcName:23090005$ long ago. Use the $npcName:11000345$ to awaken the souls.

30000154--.tooltipDescription: A relic reclaimed by an awakened soul. It can be used to restore the power of $item:13200028$.

30000155--.tooltipDescription: In ancient times, sorcerers used these chests to seal away important items. Contains $item:13200028$, which has been restored by $npcName:11001046$.

30000156--.tooltipDescription: A nameless wildflower. It's unclear how it might be useful.

30000157--.tooltipDescription: An old, dull sword. Looks pretty useless.

30000158--.tooltipDescription: A crumpled paper flower. If you open it up, you'll see an unfinished drawing of $npcName:11000010$ from $map:02000001$ on the back.

30000159--.tooltipDescription: Full of black, raw stones reclaimed from the Golden Tower.

30000160--.tooltipDescription: An agreement to forgive $npcName:11000502$ in order to avoid future conflict.

30000161--.tooltipDescription: A freshly laid golden egg. A rare item that sells at a high price.

30000163--.tooltipDescription: A key for room 1004 at the Troy Inn, where $npcName:11000179$ used to stay.

30000164--.tooltipDescription: A bundle of mail addressed to $npcName:11000492$.

30000165--.tooltipDescription: The mayer of $map:02000100$ issued this search warrant for the office of $npcName:11000526$, chief executive of the Barrota Trading Company.

30000166--.tooltipDescription: A business application filed by $npcName:11000491$ claiming oil development rights in $map:02000100$ and centered around $map:02000148$. The suggestions section is blank.

30000167--.tooltipDescription: A business application filed by $npcName:11000491$ claiming oil development rights in $map:02000100$ and centered around $map:02000148$. It has been endorsed by $npcName:11000245$.

30000168--.tooltipDescription: An expensive-looking gold bar. May not be real gold.

30000169--.tooltipDescription: A scribbled note: "Every full moon for the last five years, here I am, in this place... Why must I endure this curse?"

30000170--.tooltipDescription: A wireless energy-transmitting chip developed by Dr. Kartronic during the MK 52 project. As he was once the director of the $map:02000187$, this can also be used to open $map:02000232$.

30000171--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000114$ brought this balloon in hopes of finding its owner. A name tag on the string reads "$npcName:11000389$."

30000172--.tooltipDescription: A weapon dropped by the leader of the monsters that attacked the northeast outpost in $map:02000054$.

30000173--.tooltipDescription: A component of the latest crossbow design from $map:02000203$.

30000174--.tooltipDescription: A jewel found in a basket in $map:02000238$. The basket was once full of items to be distributed to the audience.

30000175--.tooltipDescription: A scroll listing construction materials required at $map:02000136$. Signed by $npcName:11000220$.

30000176--.tooltipDescription: Contains secret orders from $npcName:11000044$, addressed to someone in Dark Wind. The message has been sealed and cannot be read.

30000177--.tooltipDescription: This rare, nearly weightless ball of fuzz floats around in the wind. No one knows where it came from, or how it was created.

30000178--.tooltipDescription: Black, hard-rimmed glasses lost by $npcName:11000595$. Looking through the lenses makes you dizzy.

30000179--.tooltipDescription: A gelatinous substance acquired by hunting $npcName:22090107$. It has a distinctive smell that makes you dizzy.

30000180--.tooltipDescription: Lenty's favorite shoe. It was crushed under some rocks.

30000181--.tooltipDescription: Permeated with dark energy, this fragment has the power to drive the cruel-hearted further into the depths of evil. Uniting the scattered fragments creates a mirror that allows one to see into the Land of Darkness of the past. Take it to $npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$.

30000182--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000074$ commissioned this painting from $npcName:11000530$. It looks very much like $npcName:11000058$, but something seems... off.

30000183--.tooltipDescription: A letter sealed with the wax stamp of $npcName:11000075$.

30000184--.tooltipDescription: The heart of the stoniconda, a vicious snake that once terrorized the mountains of $map:02000051$. Legend says that its skin and bones melted in a river of lava, but that the heart still remained somewhere beneath the flowing magma.

30000185--.tooltipDescription: It's said that tens of thousands of $npcNamePlural:21000037$ can sprout from one of these tiny seeds.

30000186--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:22000007$ gained the power to control the wind by eating this fruit.

30000187--.tooltipDescription: A treasure passed down among traditional witches. It's said that you can use it to hold souls.

30000188--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000531$ was a celebrated poet in Maple World. This is a posthumous collection of his work. $npcName:11000531$, who runs a bookstore in $map:02000147$, signed the last page of the book as a joke.

30000189--.tooltipDescription: A sharp dragon claw that pulses with dark energy.

30000190--.tooltipDescription: A source of evil extracted from the claws of a demon. $npcName:23000025$ could use this to bring chaos and darkness to forests of $map:02000023$.

30000191--.tooltipDescription: A complete accounting of the spells of Akabonari, the pop star of witches.

30000192--.tooltipDescription: A milky-white feather taken from $npcName:11000677$. It's soft and fluffy.

30000193--.tooltipDescription: A rock imbued with the power of evil and chaos. It's often used as a crude currency in the Shadow World. <font color='#00aaef'>Can be used to purchase items from Shadow Merchants in the Shadow World Shelter.</font>

30000194--.tooltipDescription: A fragment of karma that has been shattered by a mysterious force. All that remains is a sliver of unremarkable stone.

30000195--.tooltipDescription: A plastic bag containing blended tropical fruits and ice. This refreshing treat is all the rage.

30000196--.tooltipDescription: A material for repairing broken ladders. Also used in mushroom house construction.

30000197--.tooltipDescription: A crumpled note found in $npcName:22090166$'s pocket. It reads as follows:\n"My beloved daughter, there is nothing I would not have done to trade in the hand that fate dealt us. I have moved heaven and earth to make you whole, and procured a special serum that should reverse your malady. Soon you will awaken, and things can be as they were before. Wait for me, we will be together soon."

30000198--.tooltipDescription: Flint discovered in $map:02000048$. Even the slightest friction will create sparks.

30000199--.tooltipDescription: An emblem carried by the Penumbran Host. Includes descriptions of their battle strategy written in a dark language.

30000201--.tooltipDescription: A flame made from concentrated hellfire. It can unlock $map:02000207$, where ancient treasures await.

30000203--.tooltipDescription: Glasses lost by $npcName:11000710$. Be a hero and return them.

30000204--.tooltipDescription: Monsters stole this ladle to pick on the slow-moving $npcName:11000705$.

30000205--.tooltipDescription: Sweet and sticky yellow liquid. Believed to boost energy and have an anti-aging effect.

30000206--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:29000001$ liver from $map:02000172$. It smells like a rabbit's toilet.

30000208--.tooltipDescription: A fish bait container. It's very portable.

30000209--.tooltipDescription: A key carried by employees of the palace.

30000210--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:22000011$'s cursed axe. They say that just carrying it will turn you into a zombie...

30000211--.tooltipDescription: Contains a variety of $npcName:40000022$'s everyday items, along with some important documents.

30000212--.tooltipDescription: An encoded Lumina Liberation Army message. It reads, "$map:03000135$, underground passage, parking lot."

30000213--.tooltipDescription: Details on the 12th civilian rescue plan of the Lumina Liberation Army.

30000214--.tooltipDescription: A no entry sign for construction areas.

30000215--.tooltipDescription: Explosive industrial oil. Used as an ingredient in homemade grenades.

30000216--.tooltipDescription: A crude liquid extracted from $item:20000102$. The main material for making $item:20000046$.

30000217--.tooltipDescription: A secret command from $npcName:11000076$ is written on this.

30000220--.tooltipDescription: A decorative fountain pen made of pure gold. It was awarded to $npcName:11000492$ as commendation for being an exemplary manager.

30000221--.tooltipDescription: A pendant $npcName:11000492$ kept secret for years. He looks at it whenever he misses his mother.

30000222--.tooltipDescription: This used to be $npcName:11000526$'s favorite watch. It's made of solid gold.

30000223--.tooltipDescription: A golden badge that's been passed down to the leadership of the Barrota Trading Company for generations. $npcName:11000526$'s name is engraved on it.

30000224--.tooltipDescription: Glasses with broken lenses. Since you can't wear them, you may as well sell them.

30000225--.tooltipDescription: It's not worth it to patch these old socks. Better to sell them than to be seen wearing these ratty things.

30000226--.tooltipDescription: Secondhand gum. Yuck! You should sell it to a merchant.

30000227--.tooltipDescription: This vintage wallet looks like it was dunked in toxic waste. Maybe a merchant will take it off your hands.

30000228--.tooltipDescription: A rusty nail. You should sell it to a shop.

30000229--.tooltipDescription: When your leg is broken, you use a crutch. When your crutch is broken, you sell it to a shop.

30000230--.tooltipDescription: Water used to boil herbs for potions. Can be obtained from monsters.

30000230--NA.tooltipDescription: Water used to boil herbs. Can be obtained from monsters.

30000231--.tooltipDescription: Has a rejuvenating effect. Dry before boiling. Can be obtained from monsters.

30000232--.tooltipDescription: This fruit has energy-boosting properties. Its juice is used to make potions. Can be obtained from monsters.

30000233--.tooltipDescription: A rare mushroom that thrives in dark, creepy places, like crypts. Used to make potions. Can be obtained from monsters.

30000234--.tooltipDescription: A mix of shrimp, squid, clam, and other seafood. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000235--.tooltipDescription: A medley of fruits, including lemons, oranges, grapes, and more. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000236--.tooltipDescription: A mix of vegetables, including carrots, onions, potatoes, and more. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000237--.tooltipDescription: A collection of grains, including rice, barley, wheat, and more. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000238--.tooltipDescription: A package of dairy products, including cheese, cream, and chocolate, used to bake various pastries. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000239--.tooltipDescription: Contains all sorts of flavorings for a variety of drinks. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000240--.tooltipDescription: Suspicious meat obtained from a monster. Used as a cooking ingredient.

30000241--.tooltipDescription: Suspicious seasoning obtained from a monster. Used for cooking.

30000242--.tooltipDescription: Suspicious sweetener obtained from a monster. Used for cooking or making drinks.

30000243--.tooltipDescription: A fresh chicken for your next culinary masterpiece. Can be purchased from crafting material merchants.

30000244--.tooltipDescription: This wide-tooth comb is a must-have item for the fashion-sensitive $npcName:21000013$.

30000245--.tooltipDescription: This drink will keep you hydrated while working under the scorching sun. It's $npcName:11000352$'s favorite.

30000246--.tooltipDescription: A natural insecticide made by $npcName:11000867$. While it's extremely effective against bugs, it's harmless to humans.

30000247--.tooltipDescription: It's not technically a hat, but $npcName:21000161$ uses it like one. At least it's warm!

30000248--.tooltipDescription: This used to be an apple. Long ago. Now it just stinks.

30000249--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000471$'s old camera was passed down from his father. What image was $npcName:11000471$ trying to capture with this?

30000250--.tooltipDescription: This toolbox was left behind at the outer walls of Fellowstone Tower. Filled with old, sturdy tools used by the laborers of $map:2000136$.

30000251--.tooltipDescription: The key of $npcName:40000030$, who monitors the prisoners of $map:03009023$.

30000252--.tooltipDescription: A reward given to guild members who have attained victory in the Arena of Glory. <font color='#00aaef'>These can be used to purchase items at the $map:02000001$ guild lounge or from Valor Token merchants.</font>

30000253--.tooltipDescription: A residency permit for the apartment buildings built by the Goldus Construction Company.
30000253--.guideDescription: Grants access to Maple Apartments in $map:02000002$ for 30 days.

30000254--.tooltipDescription: A residency permit for the apartment buildings built by the Goldus Construction Company.
30000254--.guideDescription: Grants access to Maple Apartments in $map:02000107$ for 30 days.

30000255--.tooltipDescription: A residency permit for the apartment buildings built by the Goldus Construction Company.
30000255--.guideDescription: Grants access to Maple Apartments in $map:02000092$ for 30 days.

30000256--.tooltipDescription: A carp with radiant golden scales. It's impossible to find a reasonable price for this.

30000257--.tooltipDescription: The monsters of $map:02000006$ love to collect shiny things. This is one of their baubles.

30000258--.tooltipDescription: The monsters of $map:02000006$ collect shiny things such as this blade. The hilt is missing.

30000259--.tooltipDescription: It is said that the water that flows from the highest tree in $map:02000024$ nourishes the whole forest. Belhi managed to bottle this water, which supposedly carries the essence of life itself.

30000260--.tooltipDescription: A bottle containing curative water from the tree at the top of $map:02000024$.

30000261--.tooltipDescription: An instrument with the power to repair the fountain of melody high up in $map:02000095$.

30000262--.tooltipDescription: A sack hidden by the GMs that is rumored to contain good fortune.

30000263--.tooltipDescription: This voucher lets you hire an assistant from Helping Hands. Show it to $npcName:11000700$ in $map:02000001$ to hire the assistant of your choice.

30000264--.tooltipDescription: A key used to open prison cells in $map:03000145$.

30000265--.tooltipDescription: The original manuscript of a book that is about to be published by $npcName:11000929$, who has a long and storied history in $map:02000051$.

30000266--.tooltipDescription: The original manuscript of a book that is about to be published by $npcName:11000929$, who has a long and storied history in $map:02000051$.

30000267--.tooltipDescription: The original manuscript of a book that is about to be published by $npcName:11000929$, who has a long and storied history in $map:02000051$.

30000268--.tooltipDescription: An ember held in the bosom of $npcName:21000255$. Although it's a tiny flame, it's able to generate a surprising amount of heat.

30000269--.tooltipDescription: It lives in the thickets of $map:02000267$ near $map:02000051$, where it feeds on the grass. It's difficult to spot due to their camouflage, but it's quite valuable as a gourmet ingredient.

30000270--.tooltipDescription: The clump of fur from the brave wolf Anka. A clump of fur like this is said to bless you with a long family line.

30000271--.tooltipDescription: A box to store Anka's fur.

30000272--.tooltipDescription: A suspicious-looking envelope containing materials for assistant item crafting. Only an assistant may open it.

30000273--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest on the 5th floor of the Golden Tower.

30000274--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest on the 1st floor of the Golden Tower.

30000275--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest on the 2nd basement of the Golden Tower.

30000276--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest in the palace Undercroft.

30000277--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest in the underground banquet hall.

30000278--.tooltipDescription: A key for the chest in the Cusp of Life.

30000279--.tooltipDescription: A key for the excellent chest in the Cusp of Life.

30000280--.tooltipDescription: A chip containing the encrypted attack parameters that were programmed into $npcName:23000054$.

30000281--.tooltipDescription: A feather plucked from the sacred griffins that have awakened in the Vayar Mountains.

30000282--.tooltipDescription: This boulder, which is supposedly the source of life for the golems of Vayar, is enchanted with the sacred aura of $map:02000055$. It may be the key to returning the golems to their original purpose.

30000283--.tooltipDescription: It is said that these horns are the source of the devilins' darkness.

30000284--.tooltipDescription: A snail commonly hunted for food in $map:02000076$. They've recently started to turn violent.

30000285--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000353$ slime is highly valued for its medicinal properties.

30000286--.tooltipDescription: Eaten raw, $npcName:21000003$ caps are deadly poison. But in the hands of an expert, they can be made into a life-saving remedy.

30000287--.tooltipDescription: First-aid medicine made by $npcName:11000832$. No one knows what the ingredients are, but no one can doubt its effectiveness.

30000288--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000973$'s diet regimen. But upon closer inspection, it looks like the plan is more focused on gaining weight, not losing it.

30000290--.tooltipDescription: Apples from the golden apple tree found in $map:02000186$. Consuming this is supposed to limber up your joints and make you very flexible.

30000291--.tooltipDescription: A cupcake that's been sweetened with cocoa tree extract instead of regular sugar.

30000292--.tooltipDescription: A packed lunch lovingly made by Mani with healthy, fresh ingredients.

30000293--.tooltipDescription: Water the cornfield with this bucket.

30000294--.tooltipDescription: A fire flower that only grows in the lava fountains of $map:02000096$. It's not common, as picking it tends to result in horrific lava burns.

30000295--.tooltipDescription: A durable $npcName:21000374$ fang. Try not to cut yourself on it.

30000296--.tooltipDescription: An orange $npcName:21000303$ mane. The spiky hairs are hot to the touch.

30000297--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000377$'s saliva. It's so toxic that it instantly disintegrates anything it makes contact with. Exercise extreme caution.

30000298--.tooltipDescription: An apple delicately balanced on a cloud of whipped cream. It's a mouth-watering sight.

30000299--.tooltipDescription: A colorful candy cane. Its delightful scents and bright appearance play with the senses.

30000300--.tooltipDescription: Soft-serve ice cream on a crispy cone. It doesn't matter how bad your day is—one bite is enough to lift your spirits.

30000301--.tooltipDescription: This ticking drum was taken from an unsuspecting $npcName:21000278$. It is said that master chronomancers can use drums like this to travel through time at will.

30000302--.tooltipDescription: A memory chip used to copy important data from a computer.

30000303--.tooltipDescription: A memory chip used to copy important data from a computer. A copy of $npcName:11000985$'s research is on here.

30000304--.tooltipDescription: A mystical crystal that reflects a wide spectrum of colors depending on the angle of the light.

30000305--.tooltipDescription: A sky blue stone that looks like it contains the essence of the azure sky itself.

30000306--.tooltipDescription: A crimson stone that evokes both a feeling of fiery intensity and humble modesty.

30000307--.tooltipDescription: A key used to wind up $npcName:21000280$'s clockwork.

30000308--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000280$'s clockwork key. Remarkably, it wasn't damaged from the fall.

30000309--.tooltipDescription: A cape in a gorgeous shade of purple. They say the most poisonous mushrooms are the ones that look the most beautiful.

30000311--.tooltipDescription: A key to the break area for traveling merchants in $map:02000042$.

30000312--.tooltipDescription: An umbrella big enough to cover anything you might carry on your back.

30000313--.tooltipDescription: A roll of toilet paper. You never know when you might need it!

30000314--.tooltipDescription: Has the power to purify and protect the forest of $map:02000023$.

30000315--.tooltipDescription: This power was created by harnessing the soul of the forest. It has the power to purify the shadows that now reside there. It was given to you by $npcName:11000031$ to brighten $map:02000206$ with the light of the forest.

30000316--.tooltipDescription: Contains the power of the sacred earth, which nurtures all life.

30000317--.tooltipDescription: This soil has been blessed by the essence of the earth itself. It has the power to purify the shadows that now reside in the forest. It was given to you by $npcName:11000001$ to repel the shadows from the griffin hatchlings in $map:02000177$.

30000318--.tooltipDescription: An incoherent jumble of numbers and symbols. Perhaps it's the coordinates for buried treasure... Or a cryptic message left by a mysterious stranger!

30000319--.tooltipDescription: Route and navigation information for the ghost ship Victoria. Could this be the clue to uncover the secret of the Victoria?

30000320--.tooltipDescription: The engineers of the Time Institute created this device in secret at $map:02000309$. It contains a code that can unlock the secrets of the Time Hall.

30000321--.tooltipDescription: The engineers of the Time Institute created this device in secret at $map:02000309$. It contains a code that can unlock the secrets of the Time Hall.

30000322--.tooltipDescription: The engineers of the Time Institute created this device in secret at $map:02000309$. It contains a code that can unlock the secrets of the Time Hall.

30000323--.tooltipDescription: White shirt and purple pants worn by $npcName:11000857$. Only the king may wear purple in $npcName:11000857$'s kingdom.

30000324--.tooltipDescription: The souls of $npcName:11000857$'s servants, released from $npcName:11000745$'s spell.

30000325--.tooltipDescription: Corn grown from $npcName:11001006$'s field. A favorite of the local monsters.

30000326--.tooltipDescription: A horned helmet. It used to belong to $npcName:21000201$, so it might be too big for person-sized people to wear.

30000327--.tooltipDescription: Show off your artistic side with this all-natural henna. A best-selling item at Cathy Mart during the summer.

30000328--.tooltipDescription: A young ram with soft pink fur.

30000329--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000304$ cast a spell of bewilderment on this mask. Whoever wears the mask is brainwashed into unconditionally obeying the person who put the mask on them.

30000331--.tooltipDescription: A ghoul who roamed the Land of Darkness. If it absorbs too much shadow energy, it will become a $item:20000103$.

30000332--.tooltipDescription: A key to one of Katramus's many doors.

30000333--.tooltipDescription: A power source for $npcName:11000145$'s time machine.

30000334--.tooltipDescription: An auxiliary power source for $npcName:11000145$'s time machine.

30000335--.tooltipDescription: The black box to $npcName:11000145$'s time machine.

30000336--.tooltipDescription: A stabilization device for $npcName:11000145$'s time machine.

30000337--.tooltipDescription: The key to a treasure chest at $map:02000301$.

30000338--.tooltipDescription: The key to a treasure chest at $map:02000302$.

30000339--.tooltipDescription: The key to a treasure chest at $map:02000303$.

30000340--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000064$ left this letter for $npcName:11000529$ before leaving.

30000342--.tooltipDescription: An audio message recorded for $npcName:11000492$'s mother.

30000343--.tooltipDescription: This fell off an old computer in $map:02000187$. The rust and corrosion has rendered it useless.

30000344--.tooltipDescription: An ice shard created when the frozen crystals of $map:02000260$ started to fracture.

30000345--.tooltipDescription: The horn of an ancient arctic $npcName:21000199$. The warriors of old would sharpen these and use them as weapons.

30000346--.tooltipDescription: Rubble from the body of a $npcName:21000089$. It is engraved with the symbols of the ancient stone giants.

30000347--.tooltipDescription: A lightweight sensor designed to analyze and track human bodies.

30000348--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11001044$'s bag full of presents for good boys and girls. It is full to bursting with wonderful gifts that are bound to delight children everywhere.

30000349--.tooltipDescription: A costume worn by $npcName:11001044$ during the holiday festival. Made of a special fabric designed to keep the wearer nice and toasty.

30000350--.tooltipDescription: A wrench that's been insulated against electromagnetic waves.

30000351--.tooltipDescription: Hardened magma. This stone is both rare and durable, making it quite valuable on the market.

30000352--.tooltipDescription: The only light source that can illuminate the crystal beacon in $map:02000192$. According to legend, whoever illuminates the beacon with a $item:30000352$ will gain eternal life.

30000353--.tooltipDescription: A hybrid energy crystal made by combining solar and electric energy. This technology is state-of-the-art, and has endless applications.

30000354--.tooltipDescription: These logs would be perfect for a fire.

30000355--.tooltipDescription: A core power source used in advanced robotics. After the AI is programmed,  you can combine this with an arc atomic chipset to create your desired robot.

30000356--.tooltipDescription: A core power source used in advanced robotics. After the AI is programmed,  you can combine this with an arc atomic chipset to create your desired robot.

30000357--.tooltipDescription: A hard drive ripped from an old computer in $map:02000187$. It's heavily encrypted.

30000358--.tooltipDescription: A rare cobra that lives in $map:02000263$. Its venom can kill an able-bodied person in a matter of minutes, so a word of warning: don't get bit.

30000359--.tooltipDescription: A magic rune that can return you to a desired point in time. It is extremely rare, even for a $npcName:21000279$.

30000360--.tooltipDescription: Focus on your true desire to make an image of it appear. The image will vanish after a short period or if your concentration breaks.

30000361--.tooltipDescription: Lays out the paths of destiny before you. Concentrate and choose wisely, for not every path leads to a happy fate.

30000362--.tooltipDescription: A gift for $npcName:11000186$'s mother. It is engraved with $npcName:11000186$'s family initials.

30000363--.tooltipDescription: A gift for $npcName:11000186$'s mother. It is engraved with $npcName:11000186$'s family initials.

30000364--.tooltipDescription: A bag containing a camera and a tripod.

30000365--.tooltipDescription: A wet piece of wood. It's too beat up to even tell what it was used for.

30000366--.tooltipDescription: This strange fruit is said to be the source of $npcName:22090007$'s ability to conjure up anything at will.

30000372--.tooltipDescription: This barrier is all that separates a performer from their legions of rabid fans.

30000373--.tooltipDescription: A petition to establish a park in memory of Ten, the legendary hero.

30000374--.tooltipDescription: A clump of fur from $npcName:21000111$'s mane. According to an old wives' tale, rubbing this fur on your skin can cure a variety of ailments.

30000375--.tooltipDescription: This chip contains the AI of one of Dr. Kartronic's earliest maid robots. Extremely valuable on the black market.

30000378--.tooltipDescription: An egg carried by the time-eating monsters that live in Ludibrium. It is said that these egg is made of halted time.

30000380--.tooltipDescription: This recording device was placed in $map:02000309$. It looks like it was intentionally destroyed.

30000381--.tooltipDescription: Video data that $npcName:11001097$ recovered from the $item:30000380$.

30000382--.tooltipDescription: A device that tracks the intensity of atmospheric and geological disturbances in order to identify energy flows.

30000384--.tooltipDescription: This sweet-smelling candy makes your mouth water. It can only be used while spinning the Lucky Wheel in $map:02000064$.

30000385--.tooltipDescription: A rare herb that can only be found in $map:52000037$. It is highly effective at neutralizing poisons, but it is difficult to harvest due to its thorns.

30000386--.tooltipDescription: A key that opens the door at $map:02000330$.

30000387--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000026$ hide. It's unusual softness makes it popular at the market.

30000388--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000067$ hide. Its incredible elasticity makes it an excellent leather when tanned.

30000389--.tooltipDescription: A leaf prepared by $npcName:11001142$ for $npcName:11000293$'s visits. It's been lightly fermented to highlight its otherwise subtle sweetness.

30000390--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000031$ sap. It is often used as a substitute for syrup thanks to its distinct sweetness.

30000391--.tooltipDescription: Extracted straight from the chocolate spring in $map:02000257$. It's a little too bitter.

30000392--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:21000009$ cap powder. It is often used as a sugar substitute because it is sweet and dissolves in water.

30000393--.tooltipDescription: An ingredient for $item:30000395$. An colorful, appetizing ingredient.

30000394--.tooltipDescription: A strange liquid taken from $npcName:11001145$'s magic pot. You're sure you followed the recipe exactly... What could have gone wrong? It's time to double-check the recipe.

30000395--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11001145$ had a craving for this candy. It's not bad, considering this was your first attempt at making it.

30000396--.tooltipDescription: This cannonball is so long forgotten that it probably doesn't even work anymore.

30000397--.tooltipDescription: A used tissue. It's disgusting, so you might as well sell it.

30000398--.tooltipDescription: An empty flattened can. Maybe a merchant will buy it from you.

30000399--.tooltipDescription: A dry maple leaf that someone pressed neatly in a book. Sell it to a shop.

30000400--.tooltipDescription: A bouquet made with an assortment of flowers. Sell it to a shop.

30000401--.tooltipDescription: A stuffed teddy bear that has all of its fur intact. Sell it to a shop.

30000402--.tooltipDescription: Putting this atop anyone's head will make them look beautiful and elegant. Sell it to a shop.

30000403--.tooltipDescription: A one-handed flashlight. Sell it to a shop.

30000404--.tooltipDescription: It's been dropped so many times that it's beyond repair. Sell it to a shop.

30000405--.tooltipDescription: All of the identifying features of this coin have been worn away by time. Sell it to a shop.

30000406--.tooltipDescription: A small whipped cream cake made to commemorate a 100 day anniversary.
30000406--.guideDescription: Use this to spin the Lucky Wheel in $map:02000064$ starting from Oct 15, 2015.

30000863-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: A stone flower that grows on cliffs. Can be used to treat wounds in the field.

30000864-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: Spring water from $map:02000095$. Revitalizes the body and soul.

30000865-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: A poisonous $npc:21000299$ tail. With proper treatment, the venom can be removed.

30000868--.tooltipDescription: An emblem that can only be possessed by fighters with a generous spirit. Compassion is always rewarded.
30000868--.guideDescription: Gather these and take them to Ruby and Bobby in exchange for $itemPlural:20300920$.

30000869-ItemPartyDungeon-.tooltipDescription: A coin that can be obtained through event dungeons. Used to spin the event dungeon roulette. You can find the event dungeon roulette in Queenstown.

30000870-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: This scroll looks unremarkable at a glance. The secrets it holds, however...

30000872-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: Hard pieces found in Monster's body. The reason why Ludibrium piece are found in monster's body is unknown.

30000873-Quest2017_2-.tooltipDescription: Report $npc:11000868$ quickly wrote and delivered. Only a enthusiastic newbie researcher can write a report with letters this small and fill up the entire paper.

Can only be used on armour between level 50 to 56. Options granted may vary depending on the armour part. Additional materials are required for transcendence, and these materials can be checked in the empowerment UI. If you attempt to transcend, the transcendence crystal will be consumed. The higher the rarity of the Transcendence Crystal, the more likely it is to be given a higher value.

39000001--.tooltipDescription: A graphic novel that tells the tragic tale of a young griffin. It's a famous story that's been told for generations among the Vayar tribes.

39000002--.tooltipDescription: A precious picture diary from $npcName:22000022$'s treasure chest. The photos from $npcName:22000022$'s past are almost unreasonably cute.

39000003--.tooltipDescription: A dismal, ragged book found on a $npcName:21000102$. Just the sight of the cover fills you with dread.

39000004--.tooltipDescription: Currently the best-selling graphic novel in all of Maple World. Though the tale is bittersweet, fans cannot get enough of this perky piggy.

39000005--.tooltipDescription: A scrapbook containing clippings about the MSL robot recall scandal that shocked the world.

39000006--.tooltipDescription: Doctor Kartronic's research notes on the Mark-52 Project. Surely there are secrets to bring to light within.

39000007--.tooltipDescription: A promotional brochure full of Tuning Motors' Strider lineup for the year. It appears multiple pages have been torn out.

39000008--.tooltipDescription: The 69th issue of a series of journals documenting the travels of the legendary adventurer Hephaestus. It discusses at length the myth surrounding the location of Stoniconda's heart.

39000009--.tooltipDescription: A guide for tourists at $map:02000124$. It goes into great detail about the types of facilities, the kinds of uniforms, and the... quirks of the warden.

39000010--.tooltipDescription: A quirky scientist's research journal concerning the Shadow World. You can tell from the tattered pages and well-worn cover that this log has been through a great deal.

39000011--.tooltipDescription: An encyclopedia that covers the monsters found in $map:02000023$ and all of their characteristics.

39000012--.tooltipDescription: A best-selling novel from one of Maple World's most renowned novelists, <font color='#00aaef'>Rawling</font>. He was inspired to write this novel when he witnessed for himself the <font color='#00aaef'>burning tree of Peronia Woods</font>.

39000013--.tooltipDescription: A nature magazine issued by the environmental protection organization <font color='#00aaef'>Green Hood</font>. It contains a thorough report concerning the pollution that's affecting $map:02000100$ and the surrounding areas.

39000014--.tooltipDescription: Stay up to date with all of the hot hairstyles with this magazine. The editors are among the most passionate and dedicated people around when it comes to hair, and are often Maple World's leading trend-setters on all things fashion. As one of their editors once said, fashion begins and ends with hair!

39000015--.tooltipDescription: A magazine focused on all aspects of architecture and interior design. The publication began when up-and-coming architects decided that there needed to be a dedicated source of information for aspiring designers out there.

39000016--.tooltipDescription: Though issues of this magazine are not published on a regular schedule, it's always praised for having consistently unique content that provides inspiration for many.

39000017--.tooltipDescription: This magazine has pages upon pages of sleek, practical, and affordable interior designs that were personally recommended by professionals.

39000018--.tooltipDescription: Each issue of this publication covers a different element of interior design. This one is all about simple designs anyone can do by themselves.

39000019--.tooltipDescription: Each issue of this publication covers a different element of interior design. This one is all about the designs of $map:02000051$.

39000020--.tooltipDescription: A new block-shaped robot toy that can be disassembled and reassembled as you like! The catalog for the Block Golem series can be used to receive 5% off on all purchases, though the hotline to order them is not always as helpful as it should be.

39000021--.tooltipDescription: Fashion tips to capture the distinct punk style of $npcName:21000013$ are here! Give the unique yet subtle charm of $npcName:21000013$ a try.

39000022--.tooltipDescription: Every moment that $npcName:11000178$ was away from $npcName:11000492$ is recorded here, from the day $npcName:11000492$ was born.

39000023--.tooltipDescription: A detailed account of the daily habits of both the palace servants and $npcName:11000492$ is recorded here.

39000024--.tooltipDescription: An exhaustive overview of $npcName:11000492$'s plans to smuggle valuables from the palace.

39000025--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000526$'s secret diary. There are subtle hints all throughout which suggest that someone else has been manipulating $npcName:11000526$ behind the scenes this entire time.

39000026--.tooltipDescription: A blueprint for building the largest clocktower in Maple World.

39000027--.tooltipDescription: A collection of pictures from fans of $npcName:11000735$ that have seen $npcName:11000735$ in person.

39000028--.tooltipDescription: The saga of $npcName:21000161$'s stinky growing pains.

39000029--.tooltipDescription: A legendary dish that only the most powerful of adventurers can eat. Do you dare?

39000030--.tooltipDescription: Experts $npcName:11000071$ and $npcName:11000072$ keep you up to date on all the latest skin tips.

39000031--.tooltipDescription: A biography of the legendary female warrior of $map:02000051$.

39000032--.tooltipDescription: The diary of the missing captain from Victoria Island.

39000033--.tooltipDescription: Book 2 of the saga of $npcName:21000161$ and his foul weapon.

50740070-Kritias_Zakum01-.tooltipDescription:
In another age, Zakum was a meager tree spirit. Even though it had little power of its own, it was beloved by the people who lived in its shade. Over time, they grew to worship it, and it fed upon their adoration.

As his faithful grew in numbers, they built a grand altar to Zakum. In its completion, it was so glorious that Zakum abandoned its tree and inhabited the great stone statue. And where once it fed upon its followers' adoration, now it fed upon their very souls.

50740071-Kritias_Inferno01-.tooltipDescription:
It's said that these were made from Infernog's actual horns. The great demon has tormented humanity over the generations, also returning whenever a new hero would rise up to seal him away.

Thanks to the new power obtained in Kritias, his rein of terror has ended once and for all.

50800001--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000512$ hails from Cadimia Island. She's a whiz at household chores, but not so good with electronics or cooking tools, leading to some silly situations. She always tries her best, so it's hard to hold a grudge.
50800001--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800002--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800003--.tooltipDescription: Inspired by $npcName:11000444$'s voyage, $npcName:11000019$ dreams of one day setting sail to explore the world. Since work at the $map:02000068$ has grown scarce, he's started accepting housekeeping jobs to save for the journey. He was never formally trained as a housekeeper, but he performs his duty with cheerful thoroughness.
50800003--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800004--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000003$ spent every last meso to get to $map:02000001$ for the ceremony with $npcName:11000075$, but then the ceremony was canceled. He realized he needed to find work if he wanted to eat, so he became a housekeeper. He's lazy and lounges in bed when the owner is away, but somehow still keeps the house squeaky clean.
50800004--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800005--.tooltipDescription: After his wife passed away, $npcName:11000225$ mourned for years. Determined to distract himself from how much he missed her, he started working as a housekeeper. His wife always took care of the cleaning, cooking, and laundry, so he has much to learn, but he's a quick study and uses his age and experience to his advantage.
50800005--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800006--.tooltipDescription: A resident of $map:02000001$, $npcName:11000002$ is a professional maid who has years of experience. She's an especially good cook. Anyone who has tasted her special unagi can never forget its taste. It's so delicious, $npcName:11000119$ is devising a plot to seduce the demons of the Land of Darkness with $npcName:11000002$'s delicious cooking.
50800006--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800007--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000420$ works tirelessly to support her timid mother. She's got a steel will and never complains, no matter how overwhelming the situation gets. She acts tough but actually has a sensitive, caring heart.
50800007--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800008--.tooltipDescription: Dr. Kartronic's first everyday use robot. $npcName:11000772$ can behave oddly when she encounters a system error but handles her chores pretty well overall. Sometimes, you'd swear she has emotions. What secrets could be hiding behind her expressionless blue eyes?
50800008--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800009--.tooltipDescription: The $npcName:11000773$ treats injuries in the treacherous Land of Darkness, but he seems more interested in mesos than in helping the sick. No one knows what he used to do before he chose this profession. Looking into his soulless eyes, you sometimes wonder if he's human at all...
50800009--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800010--.tooltipDescription: The world is $npcName:11000253$'s canvas. An artist, and proud of it, $npcName:11000253$ never lets the haters get to him. He may seem like he's in his own world, but he cares deeply about what makes people tick and the experiences that shape them. He can't resist anything new or interesting, which is how he picked up housekeeping. You can't help but wonder what interesting tidbits he knows.
50800010--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800011--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800012--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800013--.tooltipDescription: Once, $npcName:11000777$ lived in $map:02000025$ with the royal family, and she never lets anyone forget it. She's currently searching for someone to pamper her and thinks you might be a good fit for the job. If you make her happy, she might offer you some unexpected help, but only if she feels like it.
50800013--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800014--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000711$ was a member of the Bunnies. She's a bit clumsy but also cheerful and charming. She prances about, laughing about how everything's great, but she harbors a painful secret. Maybe she'll tell you if you gain her trust.
50800014--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800015--.tooltipDescription: Gorgeous, charming, and one of the most talented traders in the entire $map:02000216$, $npcName:11000515$ isn't someone you'd picture working as a servant. Something feels off, but all suspicions melt away when she captures you in her bewitching blue eyes.
50800015--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800016--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000406$ is sooo jaded with the entertainment industry and all it's superficial fame and fortune. All he wants is to return to life before he was so darn famous, but he never expected chores to be difficult! He's constantly peeking over his shoulder, afraid someone will recognize him with his make-up off.
50800016--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800017--.tooltipDescription: When $npcName:11000617$, one of $npc:11000119$'s royal guards, decided to become a servant, everyone was shocked. He's done well so far, despite being a bit indecisive at times. With $npcName:11000617$ waiting on you hand and foot in his shining armor, sometimes you feel like the empress herself.
50800017--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800018--.tooltipDescription: With endless stamina and deadly bow skills, there's no doubt that $npcName:11000547$ from $map:02000076$ will keep your home safe from all intruders. But why is a Green Hood taking on such menial work? Could there be something important $npcName:11000547$ is saving up for?
50800018--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800019--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000787$ once worked as a $map:02000100$ bartender. His dream is to be the emcee of a fabulous show, and then he can leave his servant days behind him. He loves to debate, so it can be a bit tiring conversing with him.
50800019--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800020--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000022$ is determined to captain a giant ship and discover a new world one day, which is why he's working hard to save up the money now. He may have never been on an adventure in his life, but he grew up in $map:02000062$ and knows how to talk big. Whether there's any substance behind his words remains to be seen.
50800020--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800021--.tooltipDescription: As an elf from $map:02000023$, $npcName:11000036$ has an affinity for trees and flowers. Most fairfolk refuse to have anything to do with humans, so she must have a special reason for working as an assistant. The job itself isn't difficult, but dealing with humans makes her anxious.
50800021--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800022--.tooltipDescription: He was once found wandering $map:02000051$ and begging for scraps, but he's found a new gig as a servant. No one knows his real name or where he comes from. He's grumpy and nonsensical, but if you're nice, he'll pray for you. You have a hunch he took this job just so he'd have a roof over his head.
50800022--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800023--.tooltipDescription: A member of the Barrota Trading Company, $npcName:11000097$ peddles his wares in dangerous places no one else dares venture. He's also known for his superb memory. It's strange to find him working as a servant, but some speculate is has something to do with the Company's new business plan.
50800023--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800024--.tooltipDescription: He may look young, but this fairfolk is older than you'd think. He loves to read and share everything he learns, but ask him about anything personal, and he clams right up.
50800024--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800025--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000185$ runs $map:02000123$ in $map:02000001$. She thought signing up for work as a servant would put her on the ground floor of drumming up some new clientèle, but people only seem interested in her personal life.
50800025--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800026--.tooltipDescription: $npcName:11000081$ may be shy, but he's also a whiz with magic and crafting. Unlike others of his ilk, he wants to give humans the benefit of the doubt. Nonetheless, it took him some time to work up the guts to accept a job as a servant.
50800026--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800027--.tooltipDescription: The epitome of a household servant. He's courteous and loyal, to the point you might get a little uncomfortable. The one thing he can't resist is the fragrance of a light, refreshing cup of earl gray tea in the morning.
50800027--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800028--.tooltipDescription: Self-conscious about her popularity, this maid can act coy and unfriendly when you approach her. But once you get to know her, you'll see a loving side you never expected. Just keep in mind that her bad sense of humor may throw you off at times.
50800028--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800029--.tooltipDescription: Often quiet and calm, she doesn't show much emotion and tends to be a loner. When you get to know her, you'll realize her hard exterior is merely protection for her soft heart. Maybe you're the one she's been waiting for to break through...
50800029--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

50800030--.tooltipDescription: Perfectly competent and capable, he is the ideal servant. He sees to your needs before you're even aware of them, but there's something about him... Don't try to ask him questions about himself. He prefers to keep your relationship strictly professional.
50800030--.guideDescription: \nPlace this in your home to hire an assistant. You can hire up to two assistants and ask them to craft items for you. This item must be placed on the floor.

11200092-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An accessory of the Centurion Heavy Infantry, one hundred elite soldiers who fought against an unknown being during the Great War of the past. These items wandered through the present world and the otherworld across an unfathomably long time, but the brave power that once protected their owners remains intact.</font>

11200091-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>A plain, modest, and lonely-looking accessory left behind by an unknown adventurer. Judging by the old red stains, its original owner seems to have met an unfortunate fate. Everyone called this item ominous, but somehow it feels warm and familiar.</font>

11200089-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the arms of the Terun Calibre commanders while they were in a Lapentouched state. During the process of purifying the influence of Blackshard, it was improved and reinforced so that its powerful energy could be used in a beneficial way. Since the Lapenta energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, caution and skill are required from the user, but the moment one becomes one with the equipment, the greatest power is already as good as in hand. "If even my blackened remnants can be of help... I would consider it an honor." - Ishura

11200093-Level60Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Madria's Whim]\nTriggers at a set chance when attacking. There is no telling what will happen. The effect does not apply in battlefields or arenas.</font>
11200093-Level60Item-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nA rare earring crafted from Lumieranium, the metal of the Lumieragons that no longer remains in the world. It originally shone with the brilliant golden light symbolizing the Lumieragons, but on the day Madria was born as one of the Seven Heroes, it was plated in black iron and lost its radiance.</font>

11301169-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as standard equipment for the Frontier Foundation. It was originally planned for distribution to all foundation guards, investigation teams, and participating adventurers, but records say the entire shipment was lost in a mysterious attack while being transported to the foundation. Because its price far exceeded normal standard-issue equipment, no replacement production was made. Rumor has it that the tremendous cost came from anti-dragon metal, a special metal designed for battles against dragons.</font>

11301176-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment granted to a small number of fanatics favored by Madria. Its elaborate wing-like decorations make it seem unsuitable for combat, but despite its appearance it is powerful, agile, and deadly. The core of this equipment is a powerful magical protection spell cast by Madria herself. Curiously, because this protective spell is far removed from the magic commonly used in Maple World, scholars believe this gear was prepared for battles against otherworldly beings that are difficult for ordinary people to imagine.</font>

11351106-FameChallengeDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis equipment is a protective item infused with [Anti-Magic Coating: Brite Star] technology, a product of the Sky Fortress Magic Engineering Division's member protection project. Designed to protect the user from harsh natural manacrystal environments and hazardous magical areas, this technology was developed to achieve similar or equivalent effects by applying a simple magical particle coating to standard combat gear, instead of the heavy, slow-moving environmental barrier suits. Equipment with this technology has been designated as weaponry for fighting against Infernog and is being supplied to members.</font>

11401005-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Beast's Rage Enhancement]
Beast's Rage effect is enhanced by 2x.

[Resonance with Green Lapenshard]
Becomes immune to Eupheria's curse in Emerald Prison. This effect activates only when both Beast's Rage and Beast's Rage Enhancement effects are active.</font>
11401005-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment forged from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that drove the snowfields into terror. Because it was made with technology from a distant past, it amounts to little more than leather, horns, and bones joined together without special processing, but it is said that this equipment alone is more than sufficient to fulfill its purpose. Behemoth's hide is closer to steel, its horns are compared to the battering rams that topple citadels, and the beast's rage that seeps into its bones tears apart any magic whatsoever. But one must be careful. To equip this equipment is, in a word, to become Behemoth. It means the endless craving for life must be sated for all eternity.</font>

11401038-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Energy Stabilization]
Whenever you are affected by the Unstable Lapenshard's power, the Lapenshard's energy stabilizes, increasing physical and magical damage by 3% for 180 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

[Resonance with all Lapenshards]
Immune to curse effects in Emerald Prison, Azure Flux, Terminus of Time, and Blackshard Nexus. This effect activates only when the Unstable Lapenshard's power effect is active.</font>
11401038-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the arms of the Terun Calib commanders who had been in a Lapent state. In the process of purifying the Blackshard's influence, it was refined and strengthened so that its immense energy could be turned to good. Because it draws directly on the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment, it demands the user's caution and skill, but the moment you become one with the equipment, it is as good as having claimed the ultimate power. "Even if the remnants of me, once stained black, can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

Because it draws directly on the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment, it demands the user's caution and skill, but the moment you become one with the equipment, it is as good as having claimed the ultimate power. "Even if the remnants of me, once stained black, can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

11450946-FameChallengeDungeon-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Reception Bandwidth Enhancement]
Using a faction's signal flare on an Orbis-Class Ship grants that faction's support effects for 15 minutes.

· Luminaits: HP +2000
· Darkwind: Evasion +50
· Tria Royal Guard: Accuracy +12
· Greenhood Flare: Restore 150 HP per second
· Maple Alliance: Combat Power +220

Leaving the area of use removes the effects.</font>
11450946-FameChallengeDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis equipment is a protective item incorporating [Anti-Magic Coating: Bright Star] technology, a product of the Sky Fortress Magic Engineering Department's member protection project. Developed to protect users from harsh natural mana environments and hazardous magical regions, this technology applies a simple coating of magical particles to standard combat equipment instead of heavy, movement-slowing protective suits, achieving similar or equivalent protection. Equipment bearing this technology is currently designated as armament for fighting Infernog and is being issued to members.</font>

Activates when there is one hostile target within a 10m radius.

This effect does not apply in the Battlefield or Arena.</font>
11500861-WorldBossDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nExclusive combat equipment of the Crimson Balrogs, the elite soldiers of the Balrog clan. Although made with now-forgotten techniques that modern technology cannot even repair or maintain, this equipment will not break until war has vanished from this land.</font>

11500890-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as standard equipment for the Frontier Foundation. It was originally planned for distribution to all foundation guards, investigation teams, and participating adventurers, but records say the entire shipment was lost in a mysterious attack while being transported to the foundation. Because its price far exceeded normal standard-issue equipment, no replacement production was made. Rumor has it that the tremendous cost came from anti-dragon metal, a special metal designed for battles against dragons.</font>

11500896-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment granted to a small number of fanatics favored by Madria. Its elaborate wing-like decorations make it seem unsuitable for combat, but despite its appearance it is powerful, agile, and deadly. The core of this equipment is a powerful magical protection spell cast by Madria herself. Curiously, because this protective spell is far removed from the magic commonly used in Maple World, scholars believe this gear was prepared for battles against otherworldly beings that are difficult for ordinary people to imagine.</font>

11500907-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal beast that drove the snowfields to terror. Crafted with the technology of the distant past, its hide, horns, and bones are barely pieced together without any special working, but this equipment alone is said to be more than enough to fulfill its purpose. Behemoth's hide is closer to steel, its horns are compared to a battering ram that brings down citadels, and the Beast's Fury deep in its bones tears any magic to shreds. But one must be careful. Donning this equipment means, in a word, becoming Behemoth. It means having to sate an Endless craving for life for all eternity.</font>
11500907-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Beast's Fury Enhancement]
Beast's Fury effects are enhanced 2x.

[Resonate with Green Lapenshard]
Immune to Eupheria's Curse in the Emerald Prison. This effect activates only when both Beast's Fury and Beast's Fury Enhancement effects are active.</font>
