11500918-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment of unknown identity pulled into Maple World along with a time rift of unknown cause. According to the analysis of the time traveler Endy, this equipment exists with the same phase across the time axes of the past, present, and future, and because of this trait, its appearance is said to be formed to match the level of understanding of the current point in time. Of course, no one across all of Maple World could precisely understand this analysis, but in any case, the passages in the report that looked good were that the equipment's performance is truly outstanding, that it is light and sturdy, and that the energy waves unique to extradimensional matter prevent fluctuations of the time axis.</font>

<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Acceleration Enhancement]
Acceleration effects are enhanced 2x.

[Resonate with Red Lapenshard]
Immune to Ishura's Curse in the Terminus of Time. This effect activates only when both Acceleration and Acceleration Enhancement effects are active.</font>

11550850-FameChallengeDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis protective gear incorporates [Anti-Magic Coating: Bright Star] technology and is the result of the Sky Fortress Arcanitech Department's member protection project. Developed to protect users from harsh natural mana environments or dangerous magic zones, this technology provides similar or equal protection by applying a simple magical particle coating to standard combat equipment, instead of heavy environment-shielding suits that slow the wearer's movements. Equipment currently using this technology is designated as armament to counter Infernog and is being supplied to our members.</font>

Equipment currently using this technology is designated as armament to counter Infernog and is being supplied to our members.</font>

11550861-WorldBossDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nExclusive combat equipment of the Crimson Balrogs, the Balrog clan's elite soldiers. Unlike the gear of ordinary subordinates, theirs was forged with the ancient Balrog's hellfire tempering technique, and even after many years it remains hard and powerful. Though made with a forgotten technique that even modern technology cannot repair or mend, this equipment will not break until war fades from this land.</font>

11601066-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as standard equipment for the Frontier Foundation. It was originally planned for distribution to all foundation guards, investigation teams, and participating adventurers, but records say the entire shipment was lost in a mysterious attack while being transported to the foundation. Because its price far exceeded normal standard-issue equipment, no replacement production was made. Rumor has it that the tremendous cost came from anti-dragon metal, a special metal designed for battles against dragons.</font>

11601077-ItemKR-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment granted to a small number of fanatics favored by Madria. Its elaborate wing-like decorations make it seem unsuitable for combat, but despite its appearance it is powerful, agile, and deadly. The core of this equipment is a powerful magical protection spell cast by Madria herself. Curiously, because this protective spell is far removed from the magic commonly used in Maple World, scholars believe this gear was prepared for battles against otherworldly beings that are difficult for ordinary people to imagine.</font>

11651041-WorldBossDungeon-.guideDescription:
<font color='#7A7A7A'>\nCombat equipment in which Infernog's energy is strongly settled. At the time of its creation, a wide range of research was conducted to reinforce the equipment using recovered Infernog energy, and this piece was the one that achieved magical results among them.
It is the result of successfully implanting Infernog's hellfire into the equipment. That this equipment possesses superior performance compared to other ordinary equipment is an indisputable fact, but because it uses the hellfire of an ancient demon intact, the Ruminights knights unanimously oppose the official distribution of this equipment."Some say the situation is at the edge of a cliff, but there are things you can use and things you cannot. Be satisfied that this equipment was made once." - Paladin Mason</font>
11651041-WorldBossDungeon-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Power of Black Flames]
On hit, has a set chance to activate skills using HP instead of SP for 7 seconds. The HP consumed is proportional to the SP cost. 

This effect does not apply in Battlefield or Arena.</font>

11601088-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Beast's Rage Enhancement]
The effect of Beast's Rage is enhanced 2x.

[Resonance with the Green Lapenshard]
Immune to Eupheria's curse in the Emerald Prison. This effect only activates when both the Beast's Rage and Beast's Rage Enhancement effects are active.</font>
11601088-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that plunged the snowy plains into terror. Since it was made with techniques from the distant past, it is little more than hide, horns, and bones joined together without any special processing, but this equipment is said to be more than enough to fulfill its purpose on its own. Behemoth's hide is closer to steel, his horns are compared to the battering ram that brings down citadels, and the beast's rage etched into his bones tears any magic to shreds. But you must be careful. Equipping this means, in a word, becoming Behemoth. It means the endless craving for life must be sated for all eternity.</font>

11601121-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment made by reworking the arms of the Teruncalib commanders, who were in the Lapentand state. In the process of purifying the influence of the Blackshard, it was improved and reinforced so that its formidable energy could be used in a beneficial direction. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, the user's caution and skill are required, but the moment you become one with the equipment, it is as good as having already obtained the greatest power. "Even a remnant of mine that was dyed black, if it can be of help…I consider it an honor." - Ishura

<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Enhanced Signal Bandwidth]
Using a faction signal flare on an Orbis-Class Ship grants the support effects of that faction for 15 minutes.

· Luminaits: HP +2000
· Dark Wind: Evasion +50
· Tria Royal Guard: Accuracy +12
· Green Hood Flare: Recovers 150 HP per second
· Maple Alliance: Combat Rating +220

Leaving the area cancels the effects.</font>
11651019-FameChallengeDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis protective gear incorporates [Anti-Magic Coating: Bright Star] technology, the product of the Sky Fortress Magitech Department's agent protection project. Developed to protect the wearer from harsh natural mana environments and dangerous magical regions, this technology applies a simple magical particle coating to standard combat equipment instead of a heavy, movement-slowing environmental suit, achieving similar or equivalent protection. Equipment with this technology is currently designated as armament against Infernog and is being issued to agents.</font>

11751094-FameChallengeDungeon-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Received Signal Bandwidth Enhancement]
Using faction-specific signal flares on an Orbis-Class Ship allows you to receive each faction's support effects for 15 minutes.

· Luminous : HP +2000
· Darkwind : Evasion +50
· Tria Royal Guard : Accuracy +12
· Green Hood Signal Flare : Recover 150 HP per second
· Maple Alliance : Combat Power +220

Leaving the usage area removes the effects.</font>
11751094-FameChallengeDungeon-.guideDescription: <font color='#7A7A7A'>\nThis protective equipment incorporates the [Anti-Magic Coating: Bright Star] technique, a result of the Sky Fortress magitech department's member protection project. Developed to protect users from harsh natural mana environments and hazardous magic zones, this technique applies a simple coating of magic particles to standard combat equipment instead of heavy, movement-impeding environmental shielding suits, producing similar or equivalent effects. Equipment currently utilizing this technique has been designated as weaponry against Infernog and is being supplied to members.</font>

11751116-WorldBossDungeon-.guideDescription:
<font color='#7A7A7A'>\nCombat equipment steeped in a strong presence of Infernog's energy. When it was created, extensive research was carried out to strengthen equipment using the energy recovered from Infernog, and this item was one that achieved magical success among them

11800113-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the armaments of the Terun Kalibre commanders who were in a Lapenturned state. In the process of purifying Blackshard's influence, its powerful energy was refined and strengthened to be used toward a beneficial purpose. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, the user requires caution and skill, but the moment it becomes one with you, it is as though the strongest power is already in your hands. "Even if it is but my remnant stained black, if it can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

13100295-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Precision]
On hit, you have a 10% chance to increase Accuracy by 9 for 8 seconds. This effect activates only when Winged Demon Genesis Knives are equipped in both hands.

[Specialty C]
The Precision effect is increased 3x against beings from another realm.

This effect does not apply in battlefields and arenas.</font>
13100295-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment bestowed upon the few fanatics who enjoy the favor of Madria. Because of its extravagant decoration reminiscent of wings, it looks unfit for combat, but contrary to its appearance, it is powerful, swift, and lethal. Yet the true essence of this equipment was the powerful protection spell Madria placed upon it. Strangely, this protection spell appears far removed from the magic commonly used in Maple World, and so scholars have analyzed this equipment as a tool prepared for battle against extraterrestrial beings difficult to imagine by common standards.</font>

13100296-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Beast's Wrath]\nOn hit, you have a 10% chance to increase Physical/Magic Attack by 48 for 12 seconds. This effect only activates when a Behemoth Ancient Knife is equipped in both hands.
13100296-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that drove the snowfields into terror. Since it was forged with techniques of the distant past, it amounts to little more than hide, horn, and bone bound together with little refinement, yet it is said that this equipment alone is more than enough to fulfill its purpose. Behemoth's hide is closer to steel, its horns are likened to a battering ram that brings down citadels, and the beast's fury steeped in its bones can tear any magic to shreds. But beware. Donning this equipment means, in a word, becoming Behemoth. It means that you must slake the Endless craving for life forevermore.</font>

13100297-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Acceleration]\nOn hit, you have a 10% chance to increase Accuracy by 9 and Attack Speed by 9% for 12 seconds. This effect only activates when a Aileon Sharp Point is equipped in both hands.
13100297-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An unidentified piece of equipment drawn into Maple World alongside a time crack of unknown origin. According to the analysis of time traveler Endi, this equipment exists in the same phase on the temporal axes of the past, present, and future, and because of this trait its appearance has also been shaped to match the present level of understanding. Of course, no one throughout Maple World could fully comprehend this analysis, but the passages that looked most favorable in the report were that the equipment's performance is outstanding, that it is light and sturdy, and that the energy wave peculiar to matter from beyond this universe serves to curtail temporal fluctuations.</font>

13100298-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Chameleon Shift]\nOn hit, you have a 10% chance to increase Combat Power by 1300 for 12 seconds. This effect only activates when a Black Vanguard Shadow Grief is equipped in both hands.
13100298-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Expert equipment forged for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's seven generals. Because it was crafted by working shadow-stained metal with dragon magic, it boasts not only physical defense but also a markedly strong magic protection, and this is said to be especially effective at blocking the spatial distortion effect known to be at antipathy with dragon magic.</font>

13100299-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Unstable Lapenshard Mist]\nOn hit, at the specified probability one of the powers of Life, Space, or Time is triggered, affecting up to 10 allies, including yourself, within a 6m radius. The power of Life restores 5000 HP, the power of Space increases Accuracy by 3 and Defense Probe by 3% for 15 seconds, and the power of Time increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 3% for 15 seconds. This effect only activates when a Black Purity Lapenda Dagger is equipped in both hands. This effect does not apply in battlefields and arenas.
13100299-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted by working the arms of the Terun KaliB commanders who were in the Lapented state. In the process of purifying the influence of Blackshard, it was reworked and strengthened so that the considerable energy it held could be turned toward a favorable direction. Because the Lapenta Energy accrued in the equipment can be used directly, the user must remain cautious and practiced, but the moment user and equipment become one, one might say the ultimate power is already in hand. "If even my remnant, once stained black, can prove useful... I would count it an honor." - Ishura

13100311--.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Ener Trigger]\nPhysical/Magic damage increases by 8%, and attacking while Poison Plan is learned increases combat power by 2700 for 12 seconds. The combat power increase effect cannot re-trigger within 10 seconds. This effect is activated when the same equipment is equipped in both hands, and does not activate in the battlefield or arena.</font>
13100311--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Next-generation combat equipment for commanders of the Tairen Kingdom. Developed by the artificial intelligence Jessica to win her battle against Humanitas. It is said that some of it was seized by an unidentified organization during prototype testing. It is ultra-high-performance equipment that maximizes Ener efficiency between weapons and armor, and boasts attack and defense more powerful than the Warrior set for soldiers.</font>

13100312--.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Ancient Power]\nPhysical/Magic damage increases by 8%, and attacking while in the improvisation state increases combat power by 2700 for 36 seconds. The combat power increase effect cannot re-trigger within 10 seconds. This effect is activated when the same equipment is equipped in both hands, and does not activate in the battlefield or arena.</font>
13100312--.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment modeled after Infernog. The technology applied to the equipment is that of ancient Kritias civilization. The unknown continent, Kritias. It has never been revealed 'why equipment modeled after Infernog exists here'. There are only hypotheses that the ancients revered Infernog, or that it was meant to pass on the existence of evil to later generations…. As the epitome of ancient Kritias civilization, this equipment wields powerful, weighty strength.</font>

13100320-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Combat]\nIncreases combat power by 30000 in the battlefield and arena. This effect is activated when a Reinforced Dagger of Dignity is equipped in both hands.</font>

13100328-Level70Item-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Combat]\nIncreases combat power by 30000 in the battlefield and arena. This effect is activated when a Worn Dagger of the Arena is equipped in both hands.</font>

13200288-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Hex]
On attack, there is a 10% chance to increase combat power by 372 for 12 seconds. This effect is activated when used together with the Frontier Broad Sword

[Specialization A] 
In the Frostbite Temple, the Hex effect is increased 3 times.

Effects do not apply in the battlefield or arena.</font>
13200288-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment once carried by the fearsome outlaw of the sea, Captain Moc, and his pirate crew. It was thought to be the mere gear of a pirate, but through the sea serpent's spell, it held strong affinity with all things related to water and cold. It was surely Moc's idea devised for naval combat, but this equipment's potential will likely prove effective in cold regions beyond the sea as well.</font>

13200289-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription:
<font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Body Reinforcement]
On attack, there is a 10% chance to increase attack speed by 10% for 24 seconds. This effect is activated when used together with the Frontier Buckler.

[Specialization B]
In the Madrakan Spire, the Body Reinforcement effect is increased 3 times.

Effects do not apply in the battlefield or arena.</font>
13200289-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as the Frontier Foundation's standard equipment. It was originally planned to be issued to every member of the Foundation's security forces, survey teams, and participating adventurers, but records state that the entire shipment was lost to a mysterious attack during transport to the Foundation. However, no supplementary production followed due to a price exceeding the standard for ordinary equipment, and it is rumored that the cause of that staggering price was Anti-Dragon Metal, a special metal made on the premise of fighting dragons.</font>

13400288-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment granted to the few fanatics who enjoyed Madria's favor. Because of the ornate decorations reminiscent of wings, it appears unsuited for combat, but contrary to its appearance, it is powerful, nimble, and deadly. 14000253-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Acceleration]\nAttacking has a 10% chance to increase Accuracy by 9 and Attack Speed by 9% for 12 seconds. This effect is activated when used with the Aillion Galaxy Wand.
14000253-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An unidentified piece of equipment swept into Maple World along with a temporal rift of unknown cause. According to the analysis of the time traveler Endy, this equipment exists at the same phase on the time axes of the past, present, and future, and because of this trait, its appearance is said to have formed to match the level of understanding of the current point in time. Of course, no one in all of Maple World could fully comprehend this analysis, but the parts of the report that looked promising were that the equipment's performance is outstanding, that it is light and sturdy, and that the energy waves unique to outer-space matter prevent fluctuations along the time axis.</font>

13300287-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment once carried by the fearsome outlaw of the sea, Captain Moc, and his pirate crew. This effect does not apply in Battlefield and Arena.</font>
13300288-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as the Frontier Foundation's standard equipment. It was originally planned to be issued to every member of the Foundation's security forces, survey teams, and participating adventurers, but records state that the entire shipment was lost to a mysterious attack during transport to the Foundation. However, no supplementary production followed due to a price exceeding the standard for ordinary equipment, and it is rumored that the cause of that staggering price was Anti-Dragon Metal, a special metal made on the premise of fighting dragons.</font>

13300290-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that plunged the snowfields into terror. 13300293-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Unstable Lapenshard Power]\nOn hit, at a set rate, one of the Powers of Life, Space, or Time activates and affects 10 allies including yourself within a 6m radius. This effect activates when used together with the Black Purity Lapenspell Book. This effect does not apply in Battlefield and Arena.
13300293-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the armaments of the Terun Kalib commanders who were in a Lapentuned state. During the process of purifying the influence of the Black Shard, it was reworked and strengthened so that its powerful energy could be put to beneficial use. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, it requires the user's care and skill, but the moment the equipment becomes one with its user, the greatest power is as good as already in hand. "Even a remnant of mine that was once stained black can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

However, the core of this equipment lies in the powerful magic protection spell that Madria personally cast, and since this protection spell is, strangely, far removed from the magic in common use across Maple World, scholars analyze this equipment as an item prepared for combat against beings from outer space that are difficult to even imagine.</font>

14100261-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Fury of the Beast]\nOn hit, has a 10% chance to increase Physical/Magic Attack by 48 for 12 seconds. This effect is only activated when used together with the Behemoth Ancient Long Sword.
14100261-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that plunged the snowfields into terror. Crafted with the techniques of a distant past, it amounts to little more than hide, horns, and bone joined together without much processing, but it is said that this equipment alone is more than enough to fulfill its purpose. Behemoth's hide is closer to steel, his horns are likened to the battering rams that topple citadels, and the beast's fury ingrained in his bones tears any magic to shreds. But one must be careful. Equipping this gear means, in a word, becoming Behemoth. It means having to sate an Endless craving for life for all eternity.</font>

14100262-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Acceleration]\nOn hit, has a 10% chance to increase Accuracy by 9 and Attack Speed by 9% for 12 seconds. This effect is only activated when used together with the Ailion Invader Sword.
14100262-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An unidentified piece of equipment swept into Maple World along with a temporal rift of unknown cause. According to the analysis of the time traveler Endy, this equipment exists at the same phase on the time axes of the past, present, and future, and because of this trait, its appearance is said to have formed to match the level of understanding of the current point in time. Of course, no one in all of Maple World could fully comprehend this analysis, but the parts of the report that looked promising were that the equipment's performance is outstanding, that it is light and sturdy, and that the energy waves unique to outer-space matter prevent fluctuations along the time axis.</font>

14100263-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Energy Mutation]\nOn hit, has a 10% chance to increase Combat Power by 1300 for 12 seconds. This effect is only activated when used together with the Black Vanguard Gladius.
14100263-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Elite equipment made for the army of Madria, the first of the Black Mage's Seven Disciples. Because it was crafted by working metal steeped in darkness with Dragon Magic, both its physical defense and magical protection are quite powerful, and it is said to be especially effective at blocking the spatial distortion effects known to oppose Dragon Magic.</font>

14100264-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Power of the Unstable Lapenshard]\nOn hit, at a set chance, one of the Powers of Life, Space, or Time is activated, affecting 10 allies including yourself within a 6m radius. The Power of Life restores 5000 HP, the Power of Space increases Accuracy by 3 and Defense Pierce by 3% for 15 seconds, and the Power of Time increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 3% for 15 seconds. This effect is only activated when used together with the Black Purity Lapentium Sword. This effect does not apply in Battlefields or Arenas.
14100264-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the armaments of the Terun Kalib commanders who were in a Lapentuned state. During the process of purifying the influence of the Black Shard, it was reworked and strengthened so that its powerful energy could be put to beneficial use. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, it requires the user's care and skill, but the moment the equipment becomes one with its user, the greatest power is as good as already in hand. "Even a remnant of mine that was once stained black can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

15000292-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment once carried by the fearsome outlaw of the sea, Captain Moc, and his pirate crew. 15000293-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An armament set ordered as the Frontier Foundation's standard equipment. 13400290-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>An unidentified piece of equipment swept into Maple World along with a temporal rift of unknown cause. According to the analysis of the time traveler Endy, this equipment exists at the same phase on the time axes of the past, present, and future, and because of this trait, its appearance is said to have formed to match the level of understanding of the current point in time. Of course, no one in all of Maple World could fully comprehend this analysis, but the parts of the report that looked promising were that the equipment's performance is outstanding, that it is light and sturdy, and that the energy waves unique to outer-space matter prevent fluctuations along the time axis.</font>

13200294-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Power of the Unstable Lapenshard]\nOn hit, one of the powers of Life, Space, or Time triggers at a set chance, affecting 10 allies including yourself within a 6m radius. The power of Life recovers 5000 HP, the power of Space increases Accuracy by 3 and Defense Penetration by 3% for 15 seconds, and the power of Time increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 3% for 15 seconds. This effect is only activated when used together with the Black Purity Lapentium Shield. This effect does not apply in Battlegrounds and Arenas.
13200294-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the armaments of the Terun Kalib commanders who were in a Lapentuned state. During the process of purifying the influence of the Black Shard, it was reworked and strengthened so that its powerful energy could be put to beneficial use. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, it requires the user's care and skill, but the moment the equipment becomes one with its user, the greatest power is as good as already in hand. "Even a remnant of mine that was once stained black can be of help... I consider it an honor." - Ishura

15600219-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Power of the Unstable Lapenshard]\nUpon striking, one of the powers of Life, Space, or Time is activated at a set rate, affecting 10 allies within a radius of 6m, including yourself. The power of Life recovers 5000 HP, the power of Space increases Accuracy by 3 and Defense Pierce by 3% for 15 seconds, and the power of Time increases Attack Speed and Movement Speed by 3% for 15 seconds. This effect does not apply in Battlefields or Arenas.
15600219-ItemKR-.guideDescription: Equipment crafted from the arms of Teruncarliv commanders who were in the Lapentid state. During the process of purifying the influence of Blackshard, that powerful energy alone was improved and strengthened so it could be used in a beneficial direction. Because the Lapenta Energy accumulated in the equipment can be used directly, the user requires attention and skill, but the moment you become one with the equipment, it is as good as already having the strongest power in hand. Ed"Even if my remnant, once tainted black, could be of help... I would consider it an honor." - Ishura

15300290-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: <font color='#ff8ae5' size='14'>[Beast's Fury]\nUpon striking, has a 10% chance to increase Physical/Magic Attack by 48 for 12 seconds.
15300290-ItemKR-.guideDescription: \n<font color='#7A7A7A'>Equipment made from the remains of Behemoth, the colossal monster that drove the snowy fields into terror. Crafted with technology from an age long past, it amounts to little more than hide, horns, and bone bound together without much processing, yet it is said that this equipment is more than enough to fulfill its purpose on its own. 31000883-ItemKR-.tooltipDescription: A voucher used to alter item attributes.
31000883-ItemKR-.guideDescription:
Double click to use an option change ticket.

<font color="#FFFFFF">Can only be used on Epic and Legendary grade armor, and it only changes the value of bonus options when used.</font>

<font color="#FF5F5F">When you change options using an option change ticket, the number of bonus option changes does not increase.
Items without a bonus option, or items whose bonus option change count is not displayed, cannot be used.

<font color="#FFFFFF">※ Items that fall into the following cases cannot use an option change ticket.

- Gloves with a bonus option among STR/INT/DEX/LUK</font>

40220001-SkinSocket-.tooltipDescription: A high-performance gemstone made by processing an unknown crystal that existed in Maple World. Its latent power was so strong that a long period of research was needed before it could actually be used. It is said that delicate engraving skills are required to properly harness the aurora light power that shimmers across the entire stone.
